a: Kol mezonotav shel adam ketzuvim lo merosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim, chutz mehotzaat shabbatot vehotzaat yom tov vehotzaat banav letalmud tora, sheim pachat — pochatin lo, veim hosif — mosifin lo.

Amar rabbi avahu, may keraa: "tiku vachodesh shofar (bakkese) leyom chaggenu", ezehu chag shehachodesh mitkasse bo — heve omer ze rosh hashshana, uchetiv: "ki chok leyisrael hu mishpat lelohe yaakov".
May mashma dehay "chok" lishshana dimzone hu, dichtiv: "veachlu et chukkam asher natan lahem paro". mar zutera amar, mehacha: "haterifeni lechem chukki".
Tanya: amru alav al shammay hazzaken, kol yamav haya ochel lichvod shabbat. matza behema naa, omer: zo lashshabbat. matza acheret naa hemenna — manniach et hashsheniyya veochel et harishona.

Aval hillel hazzaken — midda acheret hayta lo, shekkol maasav leshem shamayim, shenneemar: "baruch Adonai yom yom", tanya name hachi, bet shammay omrim: mechad shabbaych leshabbetaych, uvet hillel omrim: "baruch Adonai yom yom".
Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: hannoten mattana lachavero en tzarich lehodio, shenneemar: "umoshe lo yada ki karan or panav".

Metivi: "ladaat ki ani Adonai mekaddishchem", amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: moshe! mattana tova yesh li bevet genazay veshabbat shemah, vaani mevakkesh littenah leyisrael, lech vehodia otam. mikkan amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: hannoten pat letinok, tzarich lehodia leimmo.
La kashya: ha bemattana daavida leiggalloye, ha bemattana dela avida leiggalloye. shabbat name mattana daavida leiggalloye! mattan secharah la avida leiggalloye.

Amar mar, mikkan amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: hannoten pat letinok tzarich lehodia leimmo. may aved leh? shayef leh mishcha umale leh kuchela. vehaiddana dechayyshinan lichshafim, may? amar rav pappa: shayef leh meoto hammin.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: kol mitzvot shennatan lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael — natan lahem befarhesya, chutz mishshabbat shennatan lahem betzina, shenneemar: "beni uven bene yisrael ot hi leolam".
I hachi, la lianshu goyim ala? shabbat — odoe odinhu, mattan secharah — la odinhu. vei baet ema: mattan secharah name odinhu, neshama yetera — la odinhu.

Deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: neshama yetera noten hakkadosh baruch hu baadam erev shabbat, ulemotzae shabbat notlin otah hemennu, shenneemar: "shavat vayyinnafash", kevan sheshshavat vavy avda nefesh.
Ose adam tavshil meerev yom tov. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella tavshil, aval pat — la.

May shena pat dela? illema midde dimlappet baenan, ufat la melappeta — veha dayysa name dela melappeta, deamar rabbi zera: hane bavlae tafshae deachli nahama benahama. veamar rav nechumi bar zecharya mishshemeh deabbaye: mearvin bedayysa! ella: midde dela shechiach baenan, ufat shechicha, vedayysa la shechicha.

Ikka deamri, amar abbaye: lo shanu ella tavshil, aval pat — la. may tama? illema demidde dela shechiach baenan, ufat shechicha — veha dayysa la shechicha, veamar rav nechumi bar zecharya mishshemeh deabbaye: en mearvin bedayysa! ella: midde dimlappet baenan, ufat la melappeta, vedayysa name la melappeta. deamar rabbi zera: hane bavlae tafshae deachli nahama benahama.

Tane rabbi chiyyay: adashim shebbeshule kedera somech alehen mishshum eruve tavshilin. vehane mille deit behu kezayit. amar rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda: shamnunit sheal gabbe hassakkin — gorro vesomech alav mishshum eruve tavshilin. vehane mille deit behu kezayit.
Amar rav assi amar rav: dagim ketannim meluchim en bahem mishshum bishshule goyim. amar rav yosef: veim tzelaan goy — somech alehem mishshum eruve tavshilin. vei avdinhu goy kasa deharsana — asur.
Peshita! mahu detema:
b: Haresana ikkar, ka mashma lan kimcha ikkar.

Amar rabbi abba: eruve tavshilin tzerichin kezayit. ibbaya lehu: kezayit echad lechullan, o dilma kezayit lechol echad veechad? ta shema, deamar rabbi abba amar rav: eruve tavshilin tzerichin kezayit ben leechad, ben lemea.
Tenan: achalo o sheavad — lo yevashshel alav battechilla, shiyyer mimmennu kol shehu — somech alav leshabbat. may kol shehu? lav af al gav delekka kezayit? la, deit beh kezayit.

Ta shema: tavshil — ze tzali, vaafillu kavush shaluk umevushshal, vekolyays haispenin shennatan alav chammin meerev yom tov — techillato vesofo en lo shiur. may lav, en lo shiur kelal? la, en lo shiur lemala, aval yesh lo shiur lematta.
Amar rav huna amar rav: eruve tavshilin tzerichin daat. peshita, daat manniach baenan; daat mi shehinnichu lo baenan, o la baenan?

Ta shema: daavu dishmuel mearev akkulla nehardea, rabbi amme verabbi assi mearvi akkulla teverya. machriz rabbi yaakov bar idi: mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin, yavo veyismoch al shelli. vead kamma? amar rav nechumi bar zecharya mishshemeh deabbaye: ad techum shabbat.

Hahu samya dahava mesaddar matneyata kammeh demar shemuel, chazyeh dahava atziv, amar leh: ammay atzivat? amar leh: dela otivi eruve tavshilin. amar leh: semoch addidi. leshana chazyeh dahava atziv, amar leh: ammay atzivat? amar leh: dela otivi eruve tavshilin. amar leh: poshea at. lechulle alma shere, ledidach asir.
Tanu rabbanan: yom tov shechal lihyot beerev shabbat — en mearvin lo eruve techumin velo eruve chatzerot.
Rabbi omer: mearvin eruve chatzerot, aval lo eruve techumin. mippene sheatta osro bedavar haasur lo, vei atta osro bedavar hammuttar lo.
Ittemar, rav amar: halacha ketanna kamma. ushemuel amar: halacha kerabbi.

Ibbaya lehu: halacha kerabbi lekulla o lechumera? peshita dilkulla kaamar! mishshum deshalach rabbi elazar laggola: lo kesheattem shonin bevavel rabbi mattir vachachamim osrin, ella rabbi oser vachachamim mattirin. may?

Ta shema, derav tachlifa bar avdimi avad ovada kevateh dishmuel, veamar rav: techillat horaa dehay tzureba merabbanan — lekilkula. i amrat bishlama lekulla kaamar — hayeynu kilkula. ella i amrat lechumera — may kilkula ikka?
Kevan demikkalkeli ba rabbim,

a: Hayeynu kilkula. amar rava amar rav chisda amar rav huna: halacha kerabbi, uleissur.

Tanu rabbanan: yom tov shechal lihyot beshabbat, bet shammay omrim: mitpallel shemone, [veomer] shel shabbat bifne atzmah, veshel yom tov bifne atzmah. uvet hillel omrim: mitpallel sheva, matchil beshel shabbat umesayyem beshel shabbat, veomer kedushshat hayyom baemtza. rabbi omer, af chotem bah: "mekaddesh hashshabbat, yisrael vehazzemannim".

Tane tanna kammeh deravina: "mekaddesh yisrael vehashshabbat vehazzemannim". amar leh: attu shabbat yisrael mekaddeshi leh? veha shabbat mikkaddesha vekayyma. ella ema: "mekaddesh hashshabbat, yisrael vehazzemannim". amar rav yosef: halacha kerabbi, vechidtaretz ravina.

Tanu rabbanan: shabbat shechal lihyot berosh chodesh o bechullo shel moed, arvit veshacharit umincha mitpallel sheva, veomer meen hameora baavoda, veim lo amar — machzirin oto. rabbi eliezer omer: bahodaa. uvammusafin matchil beshel shabbat umesayyem beshel shabbat, veomer kedushshat hayyom baemtza.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omrim: kol makom shehuzekak lesheva, matchil beshel shabbat umesayyem beshel shabbat veomer kedushshat hayyom baemtza. amar rav huna: en halacha keoto hazzug.
Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: manniach adam eruve techumin miyyom tov lachavero, umatne.
Amar rava: manniach adam eruve tavshilin miyyom tov lachavero, umatne.
Man deamar eruve techumin — kol shekken eruve tavshilin, uman deamar eruve tavshilin — aval eruve techumin la. may tama — dilmikne shevita beshabbeta la.

Tanu rabbanan: en ofin miyyom tov lachavero. beemet amru: memallea ishsha kol hakkedera basar, af al pi sheenah tzericha ella lachaticha achat. memalle nachtom chavit shel mayim, af al pi sheeno tzarich ella lekiton echad. aval leefot — eno ofe ella ma shetztzarich lo.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: memallea ishsha kol hattannur pat, mippene shehappat neefet yafe bizman shehattannur male. amar rava: halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar.
Ibbaya lehu: mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin, hu neesar vekimcho neesar, o dilma: hu neesar veen kimcho neesar?

Lemay nafka minna? leaknoye kimcho laacherim. i amrat hu neesar vekimcho neesar — tzarich leaknoye kimcho laacherim. vei amrat hu neesar veen kimcho neesar — la tzerich leaknoye kimcho laacherim. may?

Ta shema: mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin, hare ze lo yofe velo yevashshel velo yatmin, lo lo velo laacherim. velo acherim ofin umevashshelin lo. ketzad hu ose — makne kimcho laacherim veofin lo umevashshelin lo. shema minna: hu neesar vekimcho neesar, shema minna.
Ibbaya lehu: avar veafa, may? ta shema: mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin, ketzad hu ose — makne kimcho laacherim, vaacherim ofin lo umevashshelin lo.
b: Vei ita, litne: avar veafa muttar! amar rav adda bar matna: tanna, takkanta dehettera — katane, takkanta deissura — la katane.

Ta shema: mi shehinniach eruve tavshilin — hare ze ofe umevashshel umatmin, veim ratza leechol et eruvo — harshut beyado. achalo ad shello afa ad shello hitmin — hare ze lo yofe velo yevashshel velo yatmin, lo lo velo laacherim. velo acherim ofin umevashshelin lo.
Aval mevashshel hu leyom tov, veim hotir — hotir lashshabbat, uvilvad shello yaarim. veim heerim — asur!
Amar rav ashe: haarama ka amrat — shane haarama deachmiru ba rabbanan tefe mimmezid.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: ha manni — chananya hi, veallibba devet shammay. detanya, chananya omer, bet shammay omrim: en ofin ella im ken erev befat, veen mevashshelin ella im ken erev betavshil, veen tomnin ella im ken hayu chammin temunin meerev yom tov.
Vvet hillel omrim: mearev betavshil echad, veose bo kol tzarko.
(Tenan:) hameasser perotav beshabbat, beshogeg — yochal, bemezid — lo yochal. la tzericha, deit leh pere acharine.
Ta shema: hammatbil kelav bashshabbat, beshogeg — yishtammesh bahen, bemezid — lo yishtammesh bahen.
La tzericha, deit leh mane acharine. i name, efshar bishela.
Ta shema: hamevashshel beshabbat, beshogeg — yochal, bemezid — lo yochal. issura deshabbat shane.

Bet shammay omrim: shene tavshilin. matnitin dela ki hay tanna, detanya, amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: modim bet shammay uvet hillel al shene tavshilin shetztzarich, al ma nechleku — al dag uvetza shealav, shebbet shammay omrim shene tavshilin. vvet hillel omrim: tavshil echad. veshavin, sheim pirper betza venatan letoch haddag, o sherissek kaflotot venatan letoch haddag, shehen shene tavshilin.
Amar rava: hilcheta ketanna didan, veallibba devet hillel.
Achalo o sheavad — hare ze lo yevashshel alav vechulei. amar abbaye: naktinan, hitchil beissato veneechal eruvo — gomer.
Mishna chal lihyot achar hashshabbat — bet shammay omrim: matbilin et hakkol millifne hashshabbat. uvet hillel omrim: kelim millifne hashshabbat, veadam beshabbat.
Veshavin shemmashshikin et hammayim bichli even letaharan, aval lo matbilin. umatbilin miggav legav umechavura lachavura.
Gemara dechulle alma mihat — keli beshabbat la. may tama? amar rabba: gezera

a: Shemma yittelennu beyado, veyaavirennu arba ammot birshut harabbim. amar leh abbaye: yesh lo bor bachatzero, may ikka lememar? amar leh: gezera bor bachatzero attu bor birshut harabbim.
Hatinach shabbat, beyom tov may ikka lememar? gazru yom tov attu shabbat.
Umi gazrinan? veha tenan: veshavin shemmashshikin et hammayim bichli even letaharan, aval lo matbilin. vei ita — nigzor hashshaka attu hatebala!
Vetisbera? i it leh mayim yafim, hane lema li lemebad lehu hashshaka? ella delet leh, vechevan delet leh mizhar zehir behu.
Etiveh: madlin bidli tame, vehu tahor. vei ita, nigzor dilma ate leatboleh beeneh! shane hatam, mittoch shello huttera lo ella al yede dolyo — zachur hu.

Etiveh: keli shennitma meerev yom tov — en matbilin oto beyom tov, beyom tov — matbilin oto beyom tov. veim ita, nigzor deyom tov attu deerev yom tov! tumea beyom tov milleta dela shechicha hi, umilleta dela shechicha la gezaru ba rabbanan.
Etiveh: keli shennitma beav hattumea — en matbilin oto beyom tov, bivlad hattumea — matbilin oto beyom tov. veim ita, nigzor ha attu ha!
Velad hattumea hechi mashkachat la? gabbe chohanim — kohanim zerizin hem.
Ta shema, deamar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: nidda sheen lah begadim — maaremet vetovelet bivgadeha. veim ita, nigzor dilma ate leatbole beenayyhu!
Shane hatam, mittoch shello huttera lah ella al yede malbush — zechura hi.
Rav yosef amar: gezera mishshum sechita.
Amar leh abbaye: tinach kelim divne sechita ninhu. kelim delav bene sechita ninhu, may ikka lememar? amar leh: gezera hane attu hane. etiveh kol hane teyuvata, veshanni leh kidshanninan.
Rav bivi amar: gezera shemma yeshahe. tanya kevoteh derav bivi: keli shennitma meerev yom tov — en matbilin oto beyom tov, gezera shemma yeshahe.
Rava amar: mippene shennire kimtakken keli. i hachi, adam name! adam nire kemeker.
Ha tinach mayim yafim, mayim raim may ikka lememar? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: peamim sheadam ba
b: Bashsharav, verochetz afillu beme mishra.
Tinach bimot hachamma, bimot haggeshamim may ikka lememar? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: peamim sheadam ba min hassade meluchelach betit uvetzoa, verochetz afillu bimot haggeshamim.
Tinach beshabbat, beyom hakkippurim may ikka lememar?
Amar rava: mi ikka midde divshabbat shere uveyom hakkippurim asur? ella hoil uveshabbat shere — beyom hakkippurim name shere.
Umi it leh lerava "hoil"? vehatnan: hachoshesh beshinnav — lo yegammea bahen et hachometz, aval metabbel hu kedarko, veim nitrappe — nitrappe. veramenan ala: lo yegammea ufolet, aval megammea uvolea!
Vaamar abbaye: ki tenan name matnitin, megammea ufolet tenan. verava amar: afillu tema megammea uvolea, vela kashya: kan kodem tibbul, kan leachar tibbul.
Veim ita, nema: hoil vekodem tibbul shere — leachar tibbul name shere! hadar beh rava mehahi.
Umimmay demehahi hadar beh, dilma meha hadar beh? la salka datach, detanya: kol chayyayve tevilot tovlin kedarkan, ben betisha beav ben beyom hakkippurim.
Veshavin shemmashshikin et hammayim bichli even vechulei. may "aval lo matbilin"? amar shemuel: en matbilin et hakkeli al gav memav letaharo beyom tov.

Manni matnitin? la rabbi vela rabbanan, detanya: en matbilin et hakkeli al gav memav letaharo, veen mashshikin et hammayim bichli even letaharan, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: matbilin keli al gav memav letaharo, umashshikin et hammayim bichli even letaharan.
Manni? i rabbi — kashya hashshaka, i rabbanan — kashya hatebala!
Ibbaet ema rabbi, ibbaet ema rabbanan. i baet ema rabbi: resha devarayyta beyom tov, vesefa beshabbat, vechulla matnitin beyom tov.

a: Veibbaet ema rabbanan, vechulla matnitin beshabbat.
Tanu rabbanan: keli shennitma meerev yom tov — en matbilin oto ben hashshemashot.
Rabbi shimon shezuri omer: af bachol en matbilin oto, mippene shetztzarich heerev shemesh.

Vetanna kamma la bae heerev shemesh? amar rava: ashkachtinhu lerabbanan deve rav deyatvi veka amri, bemachshavto nikkeret mittoch maasav kamippalgi. vehechi dame — kegon denaket mana bideh, verahet veazel ben hashshemashot leatboleh.
Mar savar: hay deka rahet veazel — midda yada devae heerev shemesh.
Umar savar: mechamat melachto hu dekarahet.

Veamena lehu ana: bemachshavto nikkeret mittoch maasav — dechulle alma la peligi. ki peligi kegon deittammi befachot mikkaadasha, vaata lekammeh derabbanan leshayyole: befachot mikkaadasha ittammi i la? mar savar: middeha la gemir, heerev shemesh name la gemir, umar savar: ha hu dela gemir, ha heerev shemesh gemir.
Umatbilin miggav legav. tanu rabbanan: ketzad miggav legav? harotze laasot gitto al gav kaddo,
Vechaddo al gav gitto — ose.
Ketzad mechavura lachavura? haya ochel bachavura zo, verotze leechol bachavura acheret — harshut beyado.
Mishna bet shammay omrim: meviin shelamim veen somchin alehen, aval lo olot. uvet hillel omrim: meviin shelamim veolot vesomchin alehen.

Gemara amar ulla: machloket beshalme chagiga lismoch, veolat reiyyay likrav. devet shammay savri: "vechaggotem oto chag laAdonai", chagiga — in, olat reiyyay — la. uvet hillel savri: "laAdonai", kol dela.
Aval nedarim unedavot — divre hakkol en kerevin beyom tov. vechen amar rav adda bar ahava: nedarim unedavot en kerevin beyom tov.
Metivi, amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al ola sheenah shel yom tov, sheenah kereva beyom tov, veal shelamim shehen shel yom tov, shekkerevin beyom tov.
Al ma nechleku — al ola shehi shel yom tov, veal shelamim sheenan shel yom tov. shebbet shammay omrim: lo yavi, vvet hillel omrim: yavi.

Taretz veema hachi: amar rabbi shimon ben elazar, lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al ola ushelamim sheenan shel yom tov, sheen kerevin beyom tov, veal shelamim shehen shel yom tov, shekkerevin beyom tov. al ma nechleku — al ola shehi shel yom tov, shebbet shammay omrim: lo yavi, vvet hillel omrim: yavi.

Rav yosef amar: tannae shaklat mealma?! tannae hi. detanya: shelamim habbaim mechamat yom tov beyom tov, bet shammay omrim: somech alehen meerev yom tov, veshochatan beyom tov. uvet hillel omrim: somech alehen beyom tov, veshochatan beyom tov.
b: Aval nedarim unedavot — divre hakkol en kerevin beyom tov.
Vehane tannae ki hane tannae, detanya: en meviin toda bechag hammatztzot, mippene chametz shebbah. vela baatzeret — mippene shehu yom tov. aval mevi adam todato bechag hassukkot.

Rabbi shimon omer: hare hu omer "bechag hammatztzot uvechag hashshavuot uvechag hassukkot", kol shebba bechag hammatztzot — ba bechag hashshavuot uvechag hassukkot, vechol shello ba bechag hammatztzot — eno ba bechag hashshavuot uvechag hassukkot. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: mevi adam todato bechag hassukkot, veyotze bah yede chovato mishshum simcha, veen yotze bah mishshum chagiga.

Amar mar: en meviin toda bechag hammatztzot — mippene chametz shebbah. peshita! amar rav adda bereh derav yitzchak, veamri la rav shemuel bar abba: hacha bearbaa asar askinan, vekasavar: en meviin kadashim levet happesul.
Velo baatzeret — mippene shehu yom tov. kasavar: nedarim unedavot en kerevin beyom tov.
Aval mevi adam todato bechag hassukkot. emat? illema beyom tov atzmo — veha amrat: velo baatzeret mippene shehu yom tov! ella bechullo shel moed.

Rabbi shimon omer: hare hu omer "bechag hammatztzot uvechag hashshavuot uvechag hassukkot", kol shebba bechag hammatztzot — ba bechag hashshavuot uvechag hassukkot, vechol shello ba bechag hammatztzot — eno ba bechag hashshavuot uvechag hassukkot. matkef la rabbi zera: hasheta sallote mesalletinan, nedarim unedavot mibbaya?!
Amar abbaye: behakerava kulle alma la peligi dishre. ki peligi, lemekam aleh beval teacher".
Tanna kamma savar: shalosh regalim amar rachamana — afillu shello kesidran.
Verabbi shimon savar: kesidran — in, shello kesidran — la.
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: mevi adam todato bechag hassukkot. emat? illema bechullo shel moed — hayeynu tanna kamma. ella beyom tov, vekasavar nedarim unedavot kerevin beyom tov.
Umay shena chag hassukkot denaket? rabbi elazar berabbi shimon letameh, detanya, rabbi shimon omer: lo yeamer "chag hassukkot", shebbo hakkatuv medabber. lamma neemar — lomar shezze acharon.
Rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: lomar shezze gorem.
Veyotze bah mishshum simcha, veeno yotze bah mishshum chagiga. peshita! davar shebbechova hi, vechol davar shebbechova eno ba ella min hachullin!
La tzericha, deaf al gav defaresh.
Kediva minneh rabbi shimon ben lakish merabbi yochanan: haomer hare alay toda veetze bah yede chagiga, hareni nazir

a: Vaagallach mimmeot maaser sheni, mahu? amar leh: nadur, veeno yotze. nazir, veeno megalleach.
Hahu gavra daamar lehu: havu leh arba mea zuze lifloni, velinsev beratti. amar rav pappa: arba mea — shakel, uveratte — i bae nasev, i bae — la nasev.
Tama deamar havu leh velinsev, aval i amar linsev vehavu leh, i nasev — shakel, vei la nasev — la shakel.
Yatev marimar vekaamar leha shemata mishshemeh denafsheh. amar leh ravina lemarimar: attun hachi matnitu la, anan kediva minneh resh lakish merabbi yochanan matninan la.
Tane tanna kammeh derabbi yitzchak bar abba: "vayyakrev et haola vayyaaseha kammishpat", kemishpat olat nedava. limmed al olat chova shetteuna semicha.

Amar leh: daamar lach manni — bet shammay hi, dela gamri shalme chova mishshalme nedava. dei bet hillel, kevan degamri shalme chova mishshalme nedava, olat chova name la tive kera, degamri meolat nedava.
Umimmay devet hillel shalme chova mishshalme nedava gamri? dilma meolat chova gamri, veolat chova gufa baaya kera.
May shena mishshalme nedava dela gamri — shekken metzuyin. meolat chova name la gamri — shekken kalil!
(Ella) atya mibbenayyay.

Vesavri bet shammay shalme chova la bau semicha? vehatanya, amar rabbi yose: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al hassemicha atzmah shetztzarich. al ma nechleku, al techef lismicha shechita. shebbet shammay omrim: eno tzarich. uvet hillel omrim: tzarich!

Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al techef lismicha shechita shetztzarich, al ma nechleku — al hassemicha atzmah, shebbet shammay omrim: eno tzarich, uvet hillel omrim: tzarich.

Tanu rabbanan: maase behillel hazzaken shehevi olato laazara lismoch aleha beyom tov. chavru alav talmide shammay hazzaken, amru lo: ma tivah shel behema zo? amar lahem: nekeva hi, ulezivche shelamim havetiha. kishkesh lahem biznavah, vehalchu lahem.

Veoto hayyom gavra yadam shel bet shammay al bet hillel, uvikkeshu likboa halacha kemotan. vehaya sham zaken echad mittalmide shammay hazzaken, uvava ben buta shemo, shehaya yodea shehalacha kevet hillel, veshalach
b: Vehevi kol tzon kedar shebbirushalayim veheemidan baazara, veamar: kol mi sherotze lismoch — yavo veyismoch, veoto hayyom gavra yadan shel bet hillel vekavu halacha kemotan, velo haya sham adam sheirer baddavar kelum.

Shuv maase betalmid echad mittalmide bet hillel shehevi olato laazara lismoch aleha, metzao talmid echad mittalmide bet shammay, amar lo: ma zo semicha? amar lo: ma zo shetika? shitteko binzifa, vehalach lo.
Amar abbaye: hilkach, hay tzureba merabbanan deamar leh chavreh milleta, la lahdar leh milleta tefe mimmay daamar leh chavreh, deihu amar leh: "ma zo semicha", veka mahdar leh: "ma zo shetika".

Tanya, amru lahem bet hillel levet shammay: uma bimkom sheasur lahedyot — muttar laggavoah, mekom shemmuttar lahedyot — eno din shemmuttar laggavoah? amru lahem bet shammay: nedarim unedavot yochichu, shemmuttar lahedyot veasur laggavoah!

Amru lahem bet hillel: ma lindarim unedavot — sheen kavua lahem zeman, tomar beolat reiyyay — shekkavua lah zeman. amru lahem bet shammay: af zo en kavua lah zeman, ditnan: mi shello chag beyom tov rishon shel chag — chogeg veholech kol haregel kullo, veyom tov haacharon shel chag.
Amru lahem bet hillel: af zo kavua lah zeman. ditnan: avar haregel velo chag — eno chayyayv beachrayuto.

Amru lahem bet shammay, vahalo kevar neemar: "lachem" — velo legavoah. amru lahem bet hillel, vahalo kevar neemar: "laAdonai" — kol dela. im ken, ma talmud lomar "lachem", lachem — velo legoyim, lachem — velo lichlavim.

Abba shaul omrah belashon acheret: uma bimkom shekkiratcha setuma — kirat rabbecha petucha, bimkom shekkiratcha petucha — eno din shekkirat rabbecha petucha? vechen bedin, shello yehe shulechancha male veshulechan rabbecha rekan.
Bemay ka mippalgi? mar savar: nedarim unedavot kerevin beyom tov, umar savar: en kerevin beyom tov.
Amar rav huna: ledivre haomer nedarim unedavot en kerevin beyom tov, la tema: middeorayyta michze chazu, verabbanan hu degazri behu gezera shemma yeshahe,
Ella afillu middeorayyta name la chazu. deha shete hallechem, dechovat hayyom ninhu, velekka lemigzar shemma yeshahe, veeno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov.

Ibbaya lehu: ledivre haomer nedarim unedavot en kerevin beyom tov, avar veshachat may? rava amar: zorek et haddam al menat lehattir basar baachila. rabba bar rav huna amar: zorek et haddam al menat lehaketir emurin laerev.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu nitma basar o sheavad. lerava — la zarek, lerabba bar rav huna — zarek.
Metivi: kivse atzeret sheshshechatan shello lishman, o sheshshechatan ben lifne zemannan ben leachar zemannan — haddam yizzarek vehabbasar yeachel. veim hayta shabbat — lo yizrok. veim zarak —

a: Huretza, al menat lehaketir emurin laerev. im zarak, diavad — in, lechattechilla — la! bishlama lerava nicha, ella lerabba bar rav huna kashya! kashya. veibbaet ema: shane shevut shabbat mishshevut yom tov.
Bea minneh rav avya sava merav huna: behema chetzyah shel goy vechetzyah shel yisrael, mahu leshochtah beyom tov? amar leh: muttar. amar leh: vechi ma ben ze lindarim unedavot? amar leh: orva parach!

Ki nefak amar leh rabba bereh: lav hayeynu rav avya sava demishtabbach leh mar begavveh degavra rabba hu? amar leh: uma eeved leh, ani hayyom "sammechuni baashishot rappeduni battappuchim", uvea minnay milleta devaaya tama.

Vetama may? behema chetzyah shel goy vechetzyah shel yisrael muttar leshochtah beyom tov, dei efshar lichzayit basar belo shechita. aval nedarim unedavot asur leshochtan beyom tov, dechohanim ki ka zachu — mishshulchan gavoah ka zachu.

Amar rav chisda behema chetzyah shel goy vechetzyah shel yisrael — muttar leshochtah beyom tov, dei efshar lichzayit basar belo shechita. issa chetzyah shel goy vechetzyah shel yisrael — asur leefotah beyom tov, deha efshar leh lemiflega belesha.

Metiv rav chana bar chanilay: issat kelavim bizman sheharoin ochlin mimmenna — chayyevet bechalla, umearvin bah, umishtattefin bah, umevarchin aleha, umezammenin aleha, veneefet beyom tov, veadam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach.
Veammay? veha efshar leh lemiflega belesha! shane issat kelavim, hoil veefshar lefayyeysan binvela.
Umi it leh lerav chisda "hoil"? veha ittemar: haofe miyyom tov lechol, rav chisda amar: loke, rabba amar: eno loke.
Rav chisda amar: loke, la amrinan "hoil umikkali leh orchim chaze leh — hasheta name chaze leh". rabba amar: eno loke, amrinan "hoil".
Ella: la tema "hoil veefshar", ella kegon deit leh nevela, devadday efshar lefayyeysan binvela.

Beo minneh merav huna: hane bene baga dirmo alayyhu kimcha divne chela mahu leefotah beyom tov? amar (leh): chazena i yahavi leh rifta leyanoka vela kafdi, kol chada vachada chazya leyanoka, ushere. vei lav — asur.

Vehatanya: maase beshimon hattimni shello ba emesh levet hammidrash. beshacharit metzao [rabbi] yehuda ben bava, amar lo: mippene ma lo bata emesh levet hammidrash? amar lo: balleshet baa leirenu, uvikkesha lachtof et kol hair, veshachatnu lahem egel veheechalnum, ufetarnum leshalom.
Amar lo: tameah ani im lo yatza secharchem behefsedchem, shehare amra tora: "lachem" — velo legoyim. veammay? ha chaze lemechal minneh!
Amar rav yosef: egel terefa havay. veha chaze lichlavim!

Tannae hi. detanya: "ach asher yeachel lechol nefesh hu levaddo yease lachem", mimmashma shenneemar "lechol nefesh", shomea ani afillu nefesh behema bammashma, keinyan shenneemar: "umakke nefesh behema yeshallemenna", talmud lomar "lachem".
b: "Lachem" — velo lichlavim, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer: afillu nefesh behema bammashma. im ken, ma talmud lomar "lachem" — lachem velo legoyim.
Uma raita lerabbot et hakkelavim ulehotzi et haggoyim? merabbe ani et hakkelavim — shemmezonotan alecha, umotzi ani et haggoyim — sheen mezonotan alecha.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: ulerabbi yose haggelili, deamar "lachem" velo lichlavim, hane sufele lechevata hechi shadenan lehu beyom tov?
Amar leh: hoil vachazu lehassaka. tinach beyabbishta, berattivta may ikka lememar? amar leh: chazu lehessek gadol.
Tinach beyom tov, beshabbat may ikka lememar? metaltelinan lehu aggav rifta. kedishmuel, deamar shemuel: ose adam kol tzarko befat.
Ufeliga derabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: mezammenin et haggoy beshabbat, veen mezammenin et haggoy beyom tov, gezera shemma yarbe bishvilo.
Rav acha bar yaakov amar: afillu beshabbat name la, mishshum shiyyure chosot. i hachi, didan name! didan chazu letarnegolin. didhu name chazu letarnegolin! didhu — issure hanaa ninhu.
Uletaltelinhu aggav kasa? mi la amar rava: metaltelin kanuna aggav kitmeh, af al gav deikka aleh shivre etzim!
Hatam — lav issure hanaa ninhu, hacha — issure hanaa ninhu.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: veleheve kigraf shel rei! amar leh: vechi osin geraf shel rei lechattechilla?

Adbereh rava lemar shemuel, uderash: mezammenin et haggoy beshabbat, veen mezammenin et haggoy beyom tov, gezera shemma yarbe bishvilo. marimar umar zutera, ki hava mikkela lehu goy beyom tov, amri leh: i nicha lach bemay ditricha lan mutav, vei la — tircha yattira addata didach la tarchinan.
Mishna bet shammay omrim: lo yachem adam chammin leraglav ella im ken reuyin lishtiyya. uvet hillel mattirin. ose adam medura umitchammem kenegdah.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: hay medura man katane la? divre hakkol hi, veshane lehu levet shammay ben hanaat kol gufo lahanaat ever echad, o dilma bet hillel katane la, aval bet shammay la shane lehu?
Ta shema, bet shammay omrim: lo yaase adam medura veyitchammem kenegdah. uvet hillel mattirin.

Mishna shelosha devarim rabban gamliel machmir kedivre bet shammay: en tomnin et hachammin lechattechilla beyom tov, veen zokfin et hammenora beyom tov, veen ofin pittin geritzin ella rekikin. amar rabban gamliel: mimehen shel bet abba lo hayu ofin pittin geritzin ella rekikin. amru lo: ma naase levet avich, shehayu machmirin al atzman umekillin lechol yisrael lihyot ofin pittin geritzin vachararin.

Gemara hechi dame? i deannach eruve tavshilin — may tama devet shammay? vei dela annach eruve tavshilin — may tama devet hillel? amar rav huna: leolam ema lach shello hinniach eruve tavshilin, uchede chayyav sharu leh rabbanan.
Verav huna letameh, deamar rav huna: mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin — ofin lo pat achat, umevashshelin lo kedera achat,

a: Umadlikin lo et hanner. mishshum rabbi yitzchak amru: af tzolin lo dag katan. tanya name hachi: mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin — ofin lo pat achat, vetomnin lo kedera achat, umadlikin lo et hanner, umechammin lo kiton echad, veyesh omrim: af tzolin lo dag katan.
Rava amar: leolam shehinniach — veshane hatemana, demochcha milleta deaddata deshabbeta kaaved.

Etiveh abbaye: chananya omer: bet shammay omrim: en ofin ella im ken erev befat, veen mevashshelin ella im ken erev betavshil, veen tomnin ella im ken hayu lo chammin temunin meerev yom tov. ha hayu lo chammin temunin — miha aved, veaf al gav demochcha milleta deaddata deshabbat kaaved!
Ella amar abbaye: kegon sheerav laze velo erav leze, vachananya hi, veallibba devet shammay.

Veen zokfin et hammenora. may ka aved? amar rav chinnana bar bisna: hacha bimnora shel chulyot askinan, demichaze kevone. devet shammay savri: yesh binyan bechelim, uvet hillel savri: en binyan bechelim veen setira bechelim.

Ulla ikkela leve rav yehuda, kam shammaeh zekaf le lishraga. etiveh rav yehuda leulla: hannoten shemen banner — chayyayv mishshum mavir, vehammistappek mimmennu — chayyayv mishshum mechabbe! amar leh: lav addatay.
Amar rav: kinva shere.
Bea minneh abba bar marta meabbaye: mahu lechabbot et hanner mippene davar acher? amar lo: efshar bevayit acher.
En lo bayit acher, may? efshar laasot lo mechitza. en lo laasot mechitza, may? efshar lichpot alav et hakkeli. en lo keli, may? amar leh: asur.
Etiveh: en mechabbin et habbekaat kede lachus aleha, veim bishvil shello yitashshen habbayit o hakkedera — muttar! amar leh: hahi rabbi yehuda hi, ki kaamena ana, lerabbanan.

Bea minneh abbaye merabba: mahu lechabbot et haddeleka beyom tov? hecha deikka sakkanat nefashot — la ka mibbaya li, daafillu beshabbat shere. ki kamibbaya li mishshum ibbud mamon, may? amar leh: asur.
Etiveh: en mechabbin et habbekaat kede lechus aleha, veim bishvil shello yitashshen habbayit o hakkedera — muttar! hahi rabbi yehuda hi, ki kaamena ana, lerabbanan.

Bea minneh rav ashe meammemar: mahu lichchol et haayin beyom tov? hecha deikka sakkana, kegon: rira, ditza, dema, dimata, vekaddachta, utechillat uchela — la mibbaya li, daafillu beshabbat shere. ki kamibbaya li, sof uchela ufatztzoche ena, may? amar leh: asur.
Etiveh: en mechabbin et habbekaat, veshanni leh kidshannin.

Ammemar share lemichchal ena miggoy beshabbeta. ikka deamri: ammemar gufeh kechal ena miggoy beshabbeta. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: may dataych — deamar ulla bereh derav illay kol tzorche chole osin al yede goy beshabbat, veamar rav hamenuna: kol davar sheen bo sakkana — omer legoy veose.
Hane mille, hecha dela mesayyay bahadeh. aval mar ka mesayyay bahadeh, deka ametz ufatach! amar leh: ikka rav zevid dekae kevatach, veshannayy leh: mesayyea en bo mammash.

Ammemar shera lemichchal ena beyom tov sheni shel rosh hashshana. amar leh rav ashe leammemar, vehaamar rava: met beyom tov rishon — yitasseku bo ammin, beyom tov sheni — yitasseku bo yisrael. vaafillu bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana,
b: Ma sheen ken bevetza!
Amar leh: ana kinhardae sevira li, deamri af bevetza. umay dataych — dilma meabberi leh leelul? haamar rav chinnana bar kahana: mimot ezra veelach lo matzinu elul meubbar.

Veen ofin pittin geritzin ella rekikin. tanu rabbanan, bet shammay omrim: en ofin pat ava befesach, uvet hillel mattirin. vechamma pat ava — amar rav huna: tefach. shekken matzinu belechem happanim, tefach.
Matkef la rav yosef: im amru bizrizin — yomru besheenan zerizin? im amru befat amila — yomru befat sheenah amila?
Im amru beetzim yeveshim — yomru beetzim lachim? im amru battannur cham — yomru betannur tzonen? im amru betannur shel mattechet — yomru betannur shel cheres?
Amar rav yirmeya bar abba: sheelit et rabbi beyichud, umannu — rav: may pat ava? pat merubba.

Ikka deamri, amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: sheelit et rabbi beyichud, umannu — rabbenu hakkadosh: may pat ava? pat merubba. veammay karu leh pat ava? mishshum dinfisha belisha. i name, beatreh dehay tanna, pat merubba — pat ava karu leh

Mikkedi mishshum dekatarach tircha dela tzerich hu, may irya pesach? afillu bishar yamim tovim name! in hachi name. vetanna, beyom tov defesach kae. tanya name hachi, bet shammay omrim: en ofin pat merubba beyom tov, uvet hillel mattirin.
Mishna af hu amar shelosha devarim lehakel: mechabbedin bet hammittot, umannichin et hammugemar beyom tov, veosin gedi mekullas belele fesachim. vachachamim osrin.
Gemara amar rav assi: machloket legammer, aval lehariach — divre hakkol muttar.

Metivi: en mechabbedin bet hammittot beyom tov, veshel bet rabban gamliel mechabbedin. amar rabbi eliezer bar tzadok: peamim harebe nichnasti achar abba, levet rabban gamliel velo hayu mechabbedin bet hammittot beyom tov, ella mechabbedin otan meerev yom tov, uforsin alehem sedinin. lemachar, kesheorchim nichnasin, mesallekin et hassedinin venimtza habbayit mitkabbed meelav. amru lo: im ken, af bashshabbat muttar laasot ken.

Veen mannichin et hammugemar beyom tov, veshel bet rabban gamliel mannichin. amar rabbi eliezer bar tzadok: peamim harebe nichnasti achar abba levet rabban gamliel, velo hayu mannichin et hammugemar beyom tov, ella meviin ardaskaot shel barzel umeashshenin otan meerev yom tov, ufokkin nikvehen meerev yom tov. lemachar, kesheorchim nichnasin, potchin et nikvehen venimtza habbayit mitgammer meelav.
Amru lo: im ken, af bashshabbat muttar laasot ken.
Ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar, amar rav assi: machloket lehariach, aval legammer — asur.

Ibbaya lehu: mahu leashshen? rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: asur. ushemuel amar: muttar. rav huna amar: asur, mippene shemmechabbe. amar leh rav nachman: venema mar — mippene shemmavir? amar leh: techillato mechabbe vesofo mavir.
Amar rav yehuda: al gabbe gachelet — asur.

a: Al gabbe cheres — muttar.
Verabba amar: al gabbe cheres name asur, mishshum deka moled recha. rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: sachofe kasa ashshirae beyoma tava — asur, may tama — mishshum dekamoled recha.

Umay shena mimmollo umeriach bo vekotmo umereach bo? hatam — recha miha ita, veosofe hu deka mosif recha. hacha — olode hu dekamoled recha. rava amar: al gabbe gachelet name muttar, midde dehave abbisra aggumere.

Daresh rav geviha mibbe chetil appitcha deve resh galuta: kittura shere. amar leh ammemar: may "kittura"? i kittura bide — maase umman hu, vei leashshen — asur, deha ka mechabbe! amar leh rav ashe: leolam leashshen, midde dehave abbisra aggumere.

Ikka deamri. amar leh ammemar: may "kittura"? i kittura bide — maase umman hu. i leashshen — asur deka moled recha! amar rav ashe: ana amrita nihaleh, umishshemeh degavra rabba amrita nihaleh: leolam leashshen, umidde dehave abbisra aggumere.

Veosin gedi mekullas. tanya rabbi yose omer: todos ish romi hinhig et bene romi leechol gedi mekullas belele pesachim. shelachu leh: ilmale todos atta, gozranu alecha nidduy, sheatta maachil et bene yisrael kadashim bachutz.
Kadashim salka datach?! ella ema: keen kadashim.
Mishna shelosha devarim rabbi elazar ben azarya mattir vachachamim osrim: parato yotza birtzua shebben karneha.
Umekardin et habbehema beyom tov. veshochakin et happilpelin barechayim shellahen.
Rabbi yehuda omer: en mekardin et habbehema beyom tov, mippene sheose chabbura, aval mekartzefin. vachachamim omrim: en mekardin, af lo mekartzefin.

Gemara lememra derabbi elazar ben azarya chada para haveya leh? vehaamar rav, veamri la amar rav yehuda amar rav: telesar alfe igle hava meassar rabbi elazar ben azarya meedreh kol shatta veshatta. tana: lo shello hayta, ella shel shechento hayta, umittoch shello micha bah — nikret al shemo.
Umekardin et habbehema beyom tov. tanu rabbanan: ezehu kerud veezehu kirtzuf? kerud — ketannim veosin chabbura, kirtzuf — gedolim veen osin chabbura.
Veshalosh machlokot baddavar, rabbi yehuda savar: davar sheeno mitkavven — asur. mihu: kerud — ketannim, veosin chabbura. kirtzuf — gedolim, veen osin chabbura. vela gazrinan kirtzuf attu kerud.

Verabbanan savri name kerabbi yehuda, davar sheeno mitkavven — asur, vegazrinan kirtzuf attu kerud. verabbi elazar ben azarya savar la kerabbi shimon deamar: davar sheeno mitkavven — muttar, uven kerud uven kirtzuf shere.

Amar rava amar rav nachman amar shemuel, veamri la amar rav nachman lechodeh: halacha kerabbi shimon, shehare rabbi elazar ben azarya mode lo. amar leh rava lerav nachman: velema mar, halacha kerabbi yehuda shehare chachamim modim lo! amar leh: ana kerabbi shimon sevira li, veod shehare rabbi elazar ben azarya mode lo.
b: Mishna harechayim shel pilpelin, temea mishshum shelosha kelim: mishshum keli kibbul, umishshum keli mattechet, umishshum keli kevara.
Gemara tana: tachtona — mishshum keli kibbul, emtzait — mishshum keli kevara, elyona — mishshum keli mattechet.
Mishna agala shel katan — temea midras, venittelet beshabbat, veenah nigreret ella al gabbe chelim.
Rabbi yehuda omer: kol hakkelim en nigrarin, chutz min haagala, mippene shehi koveshet.
Gemara agala shel katan — temea midras, deha samech illavay. venittelet beshabbat, mishshum deikka torat keli ala.
Veenah nigreret ella al gabbe chelim. al gabbe chelim — in, al gabbe karka — la. may tama, deka aved charitz. manni? rabbi yehuda hi, deamar: davar sheen mitkavven — asur.
Dei rabbi shimon, haamar: davar sheen mitkavven — muttar. (ditnan) rabbi shimon omer: gorer adam mitta kisse vesafsal, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot charitz.
Ema sefa, rabbi yehuda omer: en hakkol nigrarin beshabbat, chutz min haagala, mippene shehi koveshet. mippene shekkoveshet — in, aval charitz — la avda?
Tere tannae, veallibba derabbi yehuda.
Hadaran alach yom tov
En tzadin dagim min habbivarim beyom tov, veen notnin lifnehem mezonot.
Aval tzadin chayya veof min habbivarin, venotnin lifnehem mezonot.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo kol habbivarin shavin. ze hakkelal: kol

a: Hamechussar tzeda — asur, vesheeno mechussar tzeda — muttar.
Gemara ureminhu: bevarin shel chayya veshel ofot — en tzadin mehem beyom tov veen notnin lifnehem mezonot. kashya chayya achayya, kashya ofot aofot!
Bishlama chayya achayya la kashya: ha rabbi yehuda, ha rabbanan.

Ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: hatztzad tzippor lammigdal utzevi labbayit — chayyayv. labbayit hu demichayyayv, aval levivarin — la. vachachamim omrim: tzippor — lammigdal, utzevi — lagginna velechatzer velabbivarin.
Ella, ofot aofot kashya! vechi tema ha name la kashya: ha bevivar mekore, ha bevivar sheeno mekore.
Veha bayit, dichvivar mekore dame, uven lerabbi yehuda uven lerabbanan: tzippor lammigdal — in, labbayit — la!
Amar rabba bar rav huna: hacha betzippor deror askinan, sheenah mekabbelet marut. detana deve rabbi yishmael: lamma nikra shemah tzippor deror — sheddara babbayit kevassade.
Hasheta deatet lehachi, chayya achayya name la kashya: ha — bevivar katan, ha — bevivar gadol.

Hechi dame bivar katan hechi dame bivar gadol? amar rav ashe: kol hecha derahet abbatra umate la bechad shichya — bivar katan, veiddach — bivar gadol. i name: kol hecha deikka uketze uketze — bivar gadol, veiddach — bivar katan. i name: kol hecha denafli tulla dechutle ahadade — bivar katan, veiddach — bivar gadol.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer lo kol habbevarin shavin vechulei. amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi shimon ben gamliel. amar leh abbaye: halacha — mikkelal difligi!
Amar leh: umay nafka lach minna? amar leh: gemara gemor, zemorta tehe?!
Ze hakkelal kol hamechussar tzeda vechulei. hechi dame mechussar tzeda? amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol sheomer have metzuda unetzudennu.
Amar leh abbaye: veha avozin vetarnegolin, sheomrim have metzuda unetzudennu, vetanya: hatztzad avozin vetarnegolin veyone haredisaot — patur!
Amar rabba bar rav huna amar shemuel: hallalu bain lichluvan laerev, vehallalu en bain lichluvan laerev.
Vahare yone shovach veyone aliyyay, devain lichluvan laerev, vetanya: hatztzad yone shovach veyone aliyyay vetzipporim shekkinnenu bitfichin babbirot — chayyayv!
Ella, amar rabba bar rav huna amar shemuel: hallalu bain lichluvan laerev umezonotan alecha, vehallalu bain lichluvan laerev veen mezonotan alecha.
Rav mari amar: hane avidi lerabboye, vehane la avidi lerabboye. kullehu name avidi lerabboye! lichluvan kaamrinan daavidi lerabboye.

Mishna metzudot chayya veof vedagim sheasaan meerev yom tov — lo yittol mehen beyom tov, ella im ken yodea shennitztzodu meerev yom tov. umaase begoy echad shehevi dagim lerabban gamliel, veamar muttarin hen, ella sheen retzoni lekabbel hemennu.

Gemara maase listor?! chassore mechassera vehachi katane: safek muchan — asur. verabban gamliel mattir. umaase name begoy echad shehevi dagim lerabban gamliel, veamar muttarin hen, ella sheen retzoni lekabbel hemennu.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en halacha kerabban gamliel. veikka dematne la aha detanya: safek muchan, rabban gamliel mattir verabbi yehoshua oser. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehoshua. veikka dematne la aha detanya:
b: Shochatin min hannegarin beyom tov, aval lo min harshatot umin hammichmorot. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: ba umetzaan mekulekalin meerev yom tov — beyadua shemmeerev yom tov nitztzodu, umuttarin. ba umetzaan mekulekalin beyom tov — beyadua shebbeyom tov nitztzodu, vaasurin.

Ha gufa kashya, amrat: ba umetzaan mekulekalin meerev yom tov — beyadua shemmeerev yom tov nitztzodu. tama deva umetzaan mekulekalin, ha sefeka — asurin. ema sefa: ba umetzaan mekulekalin beyom tov — beyadua shebbeyom tov nitztzodu. tama deva umetzaan mekulekalin, ha sefeka — meerev yom tov nitztzodu, umuttarin.
Hachi kaamar: ba umetzaan mekulekalin meerev yom tov — beyadua shemmeerev yom tov nitztzodu, umuttarin. ha sefeka — naasa kemi shennitztzodu beyom tov, vaasurin.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi shimon ben elazar.
Veamar muttarin hem. muttarin lemay? rav amar: muttarin lekabbel. velevi amar: muttarin baachila.

Amar rav: leolam al yimna adam atzmo mibbet hammidrash afillu shaa achat. daana velevi havenan kammeh derabbi ki amra leha shemata, beureta amar: muttarin baachila, betzafra amar: muttarin lekabbel. ana dahavay be midresha — hadari bi. levi dela hava bi midresha — la hadar beh.

Metivi: goy shehevi doron leyisrael, afillu dagim hamefullamin uferot bene yoman — muttarin. bishlama leman deamar muttarin lekabbel — shappir. ella leman deamar muttarin baachila, perot bene yoman mi sharu baachila?
Uletamaych: perot bene yoman mi sharu betiltul? ella, bichvore daadime ufere dichvishi beyarka askinan, veammay kare lehu bene yoman — shehen keen bene yoman.
Amar rav pappa, hilcheta: goy shehevi doron leyisrael beyom tov, im yesh meoto hammin bimchubbar — asur. velaerev name asurin bichde sheyyeasu.
Veim en meoto hammin bimchubbar, toch hattechum — muttar,

a: Chutz lattechum — asur. vehabba bishvil yisrael ze — muttar leyisrael acher.
Amar rabba bar rav huna amar rav: hassocher ammat hammayim meerev yom tov, ulemachar hishkim umatza bah dagim — muttarin.

Amar rav chisda, middivre rabbenu nilmod: chayya shekkinnena befardes — enah tzericha zimmun. amar rav nachman: nefal chavrin, beravrevata. ikka deamri: amar rabba bar rav huna, middivre rabbenu nilmod: chayya shekkinnena befardes — enah tzericha zimmun. amar rav nachman: nefal bar chavrin beravrevata.
Hatam la ka aved maase, hacha ka aved maase.

Vela baaya zimmun? vehatanya: chayya shekkinnena befardes — tzericha lezammen, vetzippor deror — tzarich likshor bichnafeha kede shello titchallef beimmah. vezo edut sheheidu mippi shemaya veavtalyon. teyuveta.

Umi baaya zimmun? vehatanya, amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: modim bet shammay uvet hillel al shehizminan betoch hakken umatza lifne hakken — sheasurin. bamme devarim amurim — beyone shovach veyone aliyya, vetzipporim shekkinnenu bitfichin uvevira. aval avozim vetarnegolim veyone haredasiyyaot vechayya shekkinnena befardes — muttarin, veen tzerichin zimmun. vetzippor deror tzericha lekashsher bichnafeha, kede shello titchallef beimmah.
Vehamekushsharim vehamenuanain, bevorot uvevattim uveshichin uvimarot — muttarin, uveilanot — asurin, shemma yaale veyitlosh. vehamekushsharin vehamenuanain — bechol makom asurin, mishshum gazel.
Amar rav nachman, la kashya: ha ba, ha beimma. imma bezimmun saggi la? tzeda mealleyuta baaya!
Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: idde veidde bedida. ha beginna hassemucha lair, ha beginna sheenah semucha.
Mishna behema mesukkenet — lo yishchot, ella im ken yesh shehut bayyom leechol mimmenna kezayit tzali. rabbi akiva omer: afillu kezayit chay mibbet tevichatah.
Shechatah bassade — lo yevienna bemot uvemota, aval mevi beyado evarim evarim.
Gemara amar rame bar abba: hefshet venittuach beola, vehu haddin lekatztzavim. mikkan limmeda tora derech eretz: shello yochal adam basar kodem hefshet venittuach.
(Leappoke) may ka mashma lan? illema leappoke midderav huna, deamar rav huna: behema bechayyeha — bechezkat issur omedet, ad sheyyivvada lach bamme nishchata.
Nishchata — bechezkat hetter omedet, ad sheyyivvada lach bamme nitrefa.
Vehaanan tenan matnitin kidrav huna! ditnan, rabbi akiva omer: afillu kezayit chay mibbet tevichatah. may lav, mibbet tevichatah mammash?
La: mimmakom shettovachat achilatah.
Veha tane rabbi chiyyay: mekom tevichatah mammash. ella, rame bar abba
b: Orach ara ka mashma lan.

Kidtanya: lo yochal adam shum uvatzal merosho, ella mealav. veim achal — hare ze reavtan. kayyotze vo: lo yishte adam koso bevat achat, veim shata — hare ze gargeran. tanu rabbanan: hashshote koso bevat achat — hare ze gargeran, shenayim — derech eretz, shelosha — miggasse haruach.
Veamar rame bar abba: chatzuva — mekatta raglehon derashshiayya.
Netia — mekatta raglehon dekatztzavayya udevoale niddot.

Tormosa — mekatta raglehon desanehon shel yisrael. shenneemar: "vayyosifu bene yisrael laasot hara beene Adonai vayyaavdu et habbealim veet haashtarot veet elohe aram veet elohe tzidon veet elohe moav veet elohe vene ammon veet elohe felishtim vayyaazvu et Adonai velo avaduhu".

Mimmashma shenneemar "vayyaazvu et Adonai", eni yodea shello avaduhu?! uma talmud lomar "velo avaduhu" — amar rabbi elazar, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: afillu kattormos hazze sheshsholkin oto sheva peamim veochlin oto bekinnuach seuda lo asauni banay.

Tana mishshemeh derabbi meir: mippene ma nittena tora leyisrael — mippene shehen azzin. tana deve rabbi yishmael: "mimino esh dat lamo". amar hakkadosh baruch hu: reuyin hallalu shettinnaten lahem dat esh. ikka deamri: datehem shel ellu — esh. sheilmale (lo) nittena tora leyisrael — en kol umma velashon yecholin laamod bifnehem.
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish, shelosha azzin hen: yisrael baummot, kelev bachayyot, tarnegol baofot. veyesh omrim: af ez bivhema dakka. veyesh omrim: af tzalaf bailanot.
Shechatah bassade — lo yevienna bammot. tanu rabbanan: en hassome yotze bemaklo, velo haroe betarmilo. veen yotzin bechisse — echad haish veechad haishsha.
Ini?! veha shalach rabbi yaakov bar idi: zaken echad haya bishchunatenu vehaya yotze bigludeke shello, uvau veshaalu et rabbi yehoshua ben levi, veamar: im rabbim tzerichin lo — muttar.

Vesamchu rabbotenu al divre achay shakya, deamar: ana appekteh lerav huna mehine leshile umishshile lehine. veamar rav nachman bar yitzchak: ana appekteh lemar shemuel mishshimsha letulla umittulla leshimsha! hatam kidamar tama: im hayu rabbim tzerichin lo — muttar.
Amar leh rav nachman lechama bar adda sheliach tziyyon: ki salkat lehatam, akkef vezil assullama detzor, vezil legabbe derabbi yaakov bar idi uvei minneh: kisse, ma attun beh?

Addaazal lehatam, nach nafsheh derabbi yaakov bar idi. ki selek, ashkecheh lerabbi zerika, amar leh: kisse ma attun beh? amar leh, hachi amar rabbi amme: uvilvad shello yechattef. may uvilvad shello yechattef? amar rav yosef bereh derava: baaluneki.
Ini?! veha rav nachman shera la leyalta lemippak aaluneki! shane yalta divita.
Ammemar umar zutera mechattefi lehu beshabbeta derigla mishshum biatuta, veamri la mishshum ducheka detzibbura.
Mishna bechor shennafal labbor, rabbi yehuda omer: yered mumeche veyire,

a: Im yesh bo mum — yaale veyishchot, veim lav — lo yishchot. rabbi shimon omer: kol sheen mumo nikkar mibbeod yom, en ze min hammuchan —
Gemara bemay ka mippalgi? i nema beroin mumin kamippalgi, derabbi yehuda savar: roin mumin beyom tov, verabbi shimon savar: en roin mumin beyom tov, velippalgu beroin mumin dealma!
Bechor shennafal labbor itztericha leh, salka datach amena: mishshum tzaar baale chayyim laarem velassekeh kerabbi yehoshua — ka mashma lan.
I hachi, "lo yishchot"? "lo yaale veyishchot" mibbee leh! la tzericha — daavar veassekeh, salka datach amena: lishchateh, ka mashma lan.
Lishchateh?! ha tam hu! la tzericha, dinfal beh muma. veha muketze hu!
Ella: dinfal beh mum over meerev yom tov, vehasheta hava leh mum kavua. mahu detema: dedateh illaveh, venishchateh, ka mashma lan.

Tanu rabbanan: bechor tam shennafal labbor, rabbi yehuda hannasi omer: yered mumeche veyire, im yesh bo mum — yaale veyishchot, veim lav — lo yishchot. amar lo rabbi shimon ben menasya: hare amru en roin mumin beyom tov. ketzad? nolad bo mum meerev yom tov, en mevakkerin oto beyom tov. nolad bo mum
b: Beyom tov, rabbi shimon omer: en ze min hammuchan. veshavin sheim nolad hu umumo immo — shezze min hammuchan.
Daresh rabba bar rav huna: nolad hu umumo immo — mevakkerin oto beyom tov lechattechilla. amar leh rav nachman, abba tane: im avar uvikkero — mevukkar, veat amrat mevakkerin oto lechattechilla!
Amar abbaye: kevateh derabba bar rav huna mistabbera, middekatane telata bave: nolad bo mum meerev yom tov — en mevakkerin oto beyom tov. lechattechilla hu dela, ha diavad — shappir dame.
Nolad bo mum beyom tov, rabbi shimon omer: en ze min hammuchan — daafillu diavad name la. vahadar tane: veshavin sheim nolad umumo immo, shezze min hammuchan — daafillu lechattechilla name.
Veha ki ata rav oshaya, ata veayyti matnita bideh: ben shennolad bo mum meerev yom tov, uven shennolad bo mum beyom tov, chachamim omrim: en ze min hammuchan.
Veella kashya hach! hahi — adda bar ukkame hi, dimshabbesh vetane.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: matnitin name dayyka. dekatane, rabbi shimon omer: kol sheen mumo nikkar meerev yom tov — en ze min hammuchan. may en mumo nikkar? illema sheen mumo nikkar kelal — peshita, tzericha lememar?
Ella, dela itchazi lechacham meerev yom tov im mum kavua im mum over. katane mihat en ze min hammuchan, shema minna.
Bae minneh hillel merava: yesh muketze lachatzi shabbat o en muketze lachatzi shabbat? hechi dame: i deichazi ben hashshemashot — ichazi. i dela ichazi — la ichazi?
La tzericha: deichazi, vahadar iddechi, vahadar ichazi. may? amar leh: yesh muketze.
Etiveh: veshavin sheim nolad umumo immo — shezze min hammuchan. veammay? nema: hay bechor meikkara hava chaze aggav immeh, ityelid leh — iddechi leh, achzeyeh lechacham — ishteri leh!
Amar abbaye veittema rav safra: kegon deyatvi dayyayne hatam.

Ikka deamri, amar leh: en muketze lachatzi shabbat. lema mesayyay leh: veshavin sheim nolad umumo immo — shezze min hammuchan. veha bechor meikkara hava chazi aggav immeh, ityelid leh — iddechi leh, achzeyeh lechacham — ishteri leh.
Amar abbaye veittema rav safra: kegon deyatvi dayyayne hatam.

Ta shema: haya ochel baanavim, vehotir veheelan laggag laasot mehen tzimmukin, bitenim, vehotir veheelan laggag laasot mehen gerogrot — lo yochal mehen ad sheyyazmin mibbeod yom. vechen atta motze baafarsekin uvachavushin uvishar kol mine ferot.
Hechi dame? i dachazu — lema leh hazemana? i dela chazu — ki azmen lehu may have!
Vechi tema, dela yada i chazu i la chazu, vehaamar rav kahana: muketze sheyyavash veen habbealim makkirin bo — muttar.
Ella lav, dichazo veiddecho, vahadar ichazo. vei amrat en muketze, lema lehu hazemana? ella may yesh muketze? ki azmen lehu may have!
La tzericha: deichazo vela ichazo. deikka inashe deachli, veikka inashe dela achli. azmen — galli dateh, la azmen — la galli dateh.
Amar rabbi zera: ta shema mippolin vaadashim. deha polin vaadashim meikkara chazu lachos, shedinhu bikdera — iddecho lehu,

a: Gamar bishshulayyhu — chazu lehu.
Amar leh abbaye: uletamaych, tikshe lach kederot dealma, deha setam kederot dealma ben hashshemashot rotchot hen, uleureta achlinan minnayyhu!
Ella gemaro bide adam la ka mibbaya lan. ki ka mibbaya lan gemaro bide shamayim.

Rabbi yehuda nesia hava leh hahu buchera. shaddereh lekammeh derabbi amme, sevar dela lemechzeyeh. amar leh rabbi zerika veittema rabbi yirmeya: rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon — halacha kerabbi yehuda. hadar shaddereh lekammeh derabbi yitzchak nappacha, sevar dela lemechzeyeh. amar leh rabbi yirmeya veittema rabbi zerika: rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon — halacha kerabbi yehuda.
Amar leh rabbi abba: may tama la shevaktinhu lerabbanan lemebad ovada kerabbi shimon? amar leh: veat ma bidach? amar leh, hachi amar rabbi zera: halacha kerabbi shimon.
Amar man dehu: ezke veessak lehatam, veegmera lishmata mippummeh demara. ki salek lehatam, ashkecheh lerabbi zera, amar leh: amar mar halacha kerabbi shimon? amar leh: la, ana "mistabbera" amari.
Middekatane bematnitin: rabbi shimon omer kol sheen mumo nikkar mibbeod yom — en ze min hammuchan, vekatane la bevarayyta bilshon chachamim — shema minna mistabbera kevoteh.

May have ala? amar rav yosef: ta shema, detalya beashle ravreve. deamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar rabbi yose ben shaul amar rabbi mishshum kehala kaddisha devirushalayim: rabbi shimon vachaverav amru halacha kerabbi meir.
Amru? veha inhu kashshishe minneh tuva! ella: beshitat rabbi meir amaruha.

Ditnan: hashshochet et habbechor veachar kach hera et mumo — rabbi yehuda mattir. verabbi meir omer: hoil venishchat shello al pi mumeche — asur. alma kasavar rabbi meir: reiyyayt bechor lav kiriyyayt terefa, reiyyayt bechor — mechayyim, reiyyayt terefa — leachar shechita.
Uminna: reiyyayt terefa — afillu beyom tov, reiyyayt bechor — meerev yom tov.
Amar leh abbaye: attu hatam, beroin mumin peligi? biknasa peligi. deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: bedukkin shebbaayin — kulle alma la peligi deasur, mishshum demishtannin.
Ki peligi bemumin shebbagguf, rabbi meir savar: gazrinan mumin shebbagguf attu mumin shebbaayin. verabbi yehuda savar: la gazrinan.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: rabbi meir omer: hoil venishchat shello al pi mumeche — asur. shema minna: kenasa hu deka kanes, shema minna.

Amme vardinaa chaze buchera deve nesia hava. beyoma tava la hava chaze. ato vaamaru leh lerabbi amme, amar lehu: shappir ka aved dela chaze. ini? veha rabbi amme gufeh chaze! rabbi amme ki chaze — meetmol hava chaze,
b: Uveyom tov shayyole ka meshayyel hechi hava ovada. ki ha dehahu gavra deayyti buchera lekammeh derava appanya demaale yoma tava. hava yatev rava veka chayef resheh. dalli eneh vechazyeh lemumeh. amar leh: zil haiddana veta limchar.

Ki ata limchar, amar: hechi hava ovada? amar leh: hava shadyayn seare behach gisa dehutza, vahava ihu beiddach gisa. bahade devae lemechal, ayyel resheh ufarteh hutza lesifvateh. amar leh: dilma at geramt leh? amar leh: la.

Umena temra digrama asur, detanya: "mum lo yihye bo", en li ella shello yihye bo mum, minnayin shello yigrom lo al yede davar acher, shello yavi batzek o devela veyanniach lo al gabbe haozen kede sheyyavo hakkelev veyittelennu — talmud lomar: "kol mum". amar "mum", veamar "kol mum".
Mishna behema shemmeta — lo yezizenna mimmekomah. umaase veshaalu et rabbi tarfon aleha veal hachalla shennitmet, venichnas levet hammidrash veshaal, veamru lo: lo yezizem mimkomam.

Gemara lema tenan setama dela kerabbi shimon? (ditnan) rabbi shimon omer: mechattechin et haddilluin lifne habbehema, veet hannevela lifne hakkelavim. rabbi yehuda omer: im lo hayta nevela meerev shabbat — asura.
Afillu tema rabbi shimon, mode rabbi shimon bevaale chayyim shemmetu, sheasurin.

Hanicha lemar bar ammemar mishshemeh derava deamar: mode haya rabbi shimon bevaale chayyim shemmetu sheasurin, shappir. ella lemar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava deamar: chaluk haya rabbi shimon afillu bevaale chayyim shemmetu, shemmuttarim — may ikka lememar?
Targevma zeeri, bevehemat kodashim. dayka name, dekatane: aleha veal hachalla shennitmet. ma challa — dekaddisha, af behema — dekaddisha.

Ella tama dekaddisha ha dechullin — sharya. hanicha lemar bereh derav yosef mishshemeh derava, deamar: chaluk haya rabbi shimon af bevaale chayyim shemmetu shemmuttarin — shappir. ella lemar bar ammemar mishshemeh derava, deamar: mode haya rabbi shimon bevaale chayyim shemmetu sheasurin — may ikka lememar?
Hacha bemay askinan — bimsukkenet, vedivre hakkol.
Mishna en nimnin al habbehema lechattechilla beyom tov. aval nimnin aleha meerev yom tov, veshochatin umechallekin benehem.
Gemara may en nimnin? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en poskin damim lechattechilla al habbehema beyom tov. hechi aved? amar rav: mevi shete vehemot umaamidan zo etzel zo, veomer: zo kazo?
Tanya name hachi: lo yomar adam lachavero hareni immecha besela, hareni immecha bishtayim, aval omer lo: hareni immecha lemechetza velishlish velirvia.

a: Mishna rabbi yehuda omer: shokel adam basar keneged hakkeli o keneged hakkofitz. vachachamim omrim: en mashgichin bechaf moznayim kol ikkar.
Gemara may "kol ikkar"? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: afillu leshomro min haachbarim. amar rav idi bar avin: vehu detalya bitrita.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: tabbach umman asur lishkol basar bayyad. veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: tabbach umman asur lishkol basar bemayim.
Veamar rav chiyyay bar ashe: asur laasot bet yad babbasar. amar ravina: uvida shere.
Amar rav huna: muttar laasot siman babbasar, ki ha derabba bar rav huna mechattech la attelat karnata.

Rabbi chiyyay verabbi shimon berabbi shoklin mana keneged mana beyom tov. keman? la kerabbi yehuda velo kerabbanan! i kerabbi yehuda, haamar: shokel adam basar keneged hakkeli o keneged hakkofitz. keneged hakkeli — in, keneged midde acharina — la! i kerabbanan, ha amri: en mashgichin bechaf moznayim kol ikkar!
Inhu daavud kerabbi yehoshua. detanya, rabbi yehoshua omer: shoklin mana keneged mana beyom tov. amar rav yosef: halacha kerabbi yehoshua, hoil utenan bivchorot kevateh.
Ditnan: pesule hammukedashin — hanaatan lahekdesh, veshoklin mana keneged mana babbechor.
Amar leh abbaye: vedilma la hi, ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hacha, ella delekka bizyon kadashim, aval hatam deikka bizyon kodashim — la.
I name, ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella mishshum dela michaze keovadin dechol, aval hacha demichaze keovadin dechol — la.
Lememra dekafdi ahadade? veha hanhu shav binyata daato leve rabbi, veishtakkach chamesh minnayyhu be rabbi chiyyay, vela kafed rabbi shimon berabbi!
Amar rav pappa, shedi gavra benayyhu: i rabbi chiyyay verabbi yishmael berabbi yose, i rabbi shimon berabbi uvar kappara.
Mishna en mashchizin et hassakkin beyom tov, aval massiah al gabbe chavertah.

Gemara amar rav huna: lo shanu ella bemashchezet shel even, aval bemashchezet shel etz — muttar. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: ha deamrat shel even asur, la amaran ella lechaddedah, aval lehaavir shamnunitah — muttar. mikkelal divshel etz — afillu lechaddedah, name muttar.

Ikka dematne la assefa: beshel etz muttar, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: ha deamrat beshel etz muttar, la amaran ella lehaavir shamnunitah, aval lechaddedah — asur. mikkelal divshel even — afillu lehaavir shamnunitah asur.

Ikka dematne la ammatnitin: en mashchizin et hassakkin beyom tov, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella lechaddedah, aval lehaavir shamnunitah — muttar, mikkelal deal gabbe chavertah — afillu lechaddedah, name muttar.

Veikka dematne la assefa: aval massiah al gabbe chavertah, amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella lehaavir shamnunitah, aval lechaddedah — asur. mikkelal divmashchezet — afillu lehaavir shamnunitah asur.
Man tanna divmashchezet asur? amar rav chisda: dela kerabbi yehuda. detanya: en ben yom tov lashshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad. rabbi yehuda mattir af machshire ochel nefesh.
Amar leh rava lerav chisda: darshinan mishshemach halacha kerabbi yehuda. amar leh: yehe raava dechol ki hane mille mealleyayta tidreshun mishshemay.
Amar rav nechemya bereh derav yosef: hava kaemna kammeh derava, vahava ka
b: Meabbar lesakkina appumma dedikkula, veamri leh: lechaddedah ka aved mar, o lehaavir shamnunitah? veamar li: lehaavir shamnunitah. vachazeti ledateh dilchaddedah ka aved, vekasavar: halacha, veen morin ken.

Veamar abbaye: hava kaemna kammeh demar, vahava ka meabbar sakkina assifta derichya. vaamari leh: lechaddedah ka bae mar, o lehaavir shamnunitah? veamar li: lehaavir shamnunitah. vachaziti ledateh dilchaddedah ka aved, vekasavar: halacha, veen morin ken.
Ibbaya lehu: mahu lehareot sakkin lechacham beyom tov? rav mari bereh derav bizna share, verabbanan asri. verav yosef amar: talmid chacham roe leatzmo, umashilah laacherim.
Veamar rav yosef: sakkin sheamda — muttar lechaddedah beyom tov. vehane mille hu defaska aggav ducheka.

Darash rav chisda, veittema rav yosef: echad sakkin shennifgema, veechad shappud shennirtzam, veechad gerifat tannur vechirayim beyom tov — banu lemachloket rabbi yehuda verabbanan. detanya: en ben yom tov lashshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad. rabbi yehuda mattir af machshire ochel nefesh.
May tama detanna kamma — amar kera: "hu levaddo yease lachem". "hu" — velo machshirav. verabbi yehuda, amar kera: "lachem", lachem — lechol tzorchechem.
Vetanna kamma, ha ketiv "lachem"? amar lach: hahu, "lachem" — velo legoyim.
Veiddach name, ha ketiv "hu", amar lach: ketiv "hu", uchetiv "lachem", vela kashya: kan bemachshirin sheefshar laasotan meerev yom tov, kan bemachshirin shei efshar laasotan meerev yom tov.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shappud shennirtzaf — asur letakkeno beyom tov. peshita! la tzericha, deaf al gav demippeshit bideh.
Veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shappud shetztzalu bo basar — asur letaltelo beyom tov. rav adda bar ahava amar rav malkiyyo: shomto umannicho bekeren zavit.
Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav huna: vehu sheyyesh alav kezayit basar. ravina amar: af al pi sheen alav basar — muttar letaltelo, midde dehave akkotz birshut harabbim.
Amar rav chinnana bereh derav ika: shappud, shefachot, vegumot — rav malkiyyo.
Belorit, efer mikle, ugevina — rav malkiyya.
Rav pappa amar: matnitin umatnita — rav malkiyya. shematata — rav malkiyyo. vesimanaych: matnitin malketa. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu shefachot.
Mishna lo yomar adam lattabbach: shekol li bedinar basar, aval shochet umechallek benehem.
Gemara hechi aved? ki ha

a: Divsura amri: tarta ufalgu tarta. benaresh amri: chelka ufalgu chelka. befumebdita amri: uzeya ufalgu uzeya. binhar pekod uvemata machseya amri: riva ufalgu riva.

Mishna omer adam lachavero: malle li keli ze, aval lo bemidda. rabbi yehuda omer: im haya keli shel midda — lo yemalleennu. maase beabba shaul ben batnit, shehaya memalle middotav meerev yom tov venotnan lallakochot beyom tov.
Abba shaul omer: af bammoed ose ken, mippene berure hammiddot. vachachamim omrim: af bachol ose ken, mippene mitztzuy hammiddot.

Gemara may "aval lo bemidda"? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: aval lo bichli hameyuchad lemidda. aval keli haomed lemidda — yemalleennu. vaata rabbi yehuda lememar afillu keli haomed lemidda lo yemalleennu.

Alma gabbe simchat yom tov rabbi yehuda lechumera verabbanan lekulla? veha ippecha shaminan lehu! ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: shokel adam basar keneged hakkeli ucheneged hakkofitz, vachachamim omrim: en mashgichin bechaf moznayim kol ikkar. alma rabbi yehuda lekulla verabbanan lechumera. kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda, kashya derabbanan adderabbanan!
Derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya: hatam besheeno omed lemidda, hacha beomed lemidda.
Derabbanan adderabbanan name la kashya: hatam ka aved kidavdin bechol, hacha la ka aved kidavdin bechol.
Rava amar: may "aval lo bemidda" — shello yizkor lo shem midda, aval keli hameyuchad lemidda — yemalleennu. vaata rabbi yehuda lememar: keli hameyuchad lemidda — lo yemalleennu.

Alma gabbe simchat yom tov rabbi yehuda lechumera verabbanan lekulla? veha ippecha shaminan lehu! ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: shokel adam basar keneged hakkeli ucheneged hakkofitz, vachachamim omrim: en mashgichin bechaf moznayim kol ikkar. alma rabbi yehuda lekulla verabbanan lechumera. kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda, kashya derabbanan adderabbanan!

Derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya: hatam besheeno meyuchad lemidda, hacha meyuchad lemidda. derabbanan adderabbanan name la kashya: hatam ka aved kidavdin bechol, hacha la kaaved kidavdin bechol, deavdi inashe dimkarvi chamra bemana dechila veshatu.
Maase beabba shaul ben batnit. tana: af bammoed ose ken mippene bittul bet hammidrash.
Tanu rabbanan: hu kanas shelosh meot garve yayin mibberure hammiddot, vachaverav kansu shelosh meot garve shemen mimmitztzuy hammiddot, vehevium lifne haggizbarim lirushalayim.
Amru lahem: i attem zekukim lechach. amru lahem: af anu en retzonenu bechach.
Amru lahem: hoil vehechmartem al atzmechem — asu mehem tzorche rabbim. detanya: gazal veeno yodea mimmi gazal — yaase bahem tzorche rabbim. may ninhu? amar rav chisda: borot, shichin umearot.

Adbereh rav chisda lerabbana ukeva, uderash: lo yimdod adam seorim veyitten lifne behemto beyom tov, aval koder hu kav o kabbim venoten lifne behemto, veeno choshesh. vehannachtom moded tavlin venoten letoch kederato, kede shello yakdiach tavshilo.
Amar rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: modedet ishsha kemach beyom tov venotenet letoch issatah kede shettittol challa beayin yafa. ushemuel amar: asur. veha tana deve shemuel, muttar!
Amar abbaye: hasheta deamar shemuel asur, vetana deve shemuel muttar,
b: Shemuel — halacha lemaase ata leashmoinan.
Tanu rabbanan: en shonin kemach beyom tov. mishshum rabbi pappeyays verabbi yehuda ben betira amru: shonin. veshavin sheim nafal letochan tzeror o kesam, sheshshonin.
Tane tanna kammeh deravina: en shonin kemach beyom tov, aval nafal tzeror o kesam — borer beyado. amar leh: kol shekken deasur, dehave leh kevorer.

Daresh rava bar rav huna zute appitcha dinhardea: shonin kemach beyom tov. amar lehu rav nachman: puku veemaru leh leabba: shekila tevutach veshadya[1] achizre, pok chazi kamma maholata haderan binhardea.

Devethu derav yosef nahala kimcha aggabba demaholta. amar la: chazay, daana rifta meallayta baena. devethu derav ashe nahala kimcha aggabba defatura. amar rav ashe: ha didan, beratte derame bar chama, verame bar chama mara deovada hava, vei lav dachazay mibbe nasha la hava avda.
Mishna holech adam etzel chenvani haragil etzlo veomer lo: ten li betzim veegozim beminyan, shekken derech baal habbayit lihyot mone betoch beto.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: holech adam etzel roe haragil etzlo veomer lo: ten li gedi echad o tale echad. etzel tabbach haragil etzlo veomer lo: ten li kaf achat o yarech achat. etzel pattam haragil etzlo veomer lo: ten li tor echad o gozal echad. etzel nachtom haragil etzlo veomer lo: ten li kikkar echad o geluseka achat.

Veetzel chenvani haragil etzlo veomer lo: ten li esrim betzim, o chamishshim egozim, asara afarsekin, vachamishsha rimmonim veetrog echad. uvilvad shello yazkir lo sechum midda. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: uvilvad shello yazkir lo sechum mikkach.
Hadaran alach en tzadin
Hammevi kadde yayin mimmakom lemakom — lo yeviem besal uvekuppa, aval mevi hu al ketefo o lefanav. vechen hammolich et hatteven — lo yafshil et hakkuppa laachorav, aval meviah hu beyado. umatchilin

a: Baaremat hatteven, aval lo baetzim shebbammuketze.
Gemara tana: im i efshar leshannot — muttar.

Atkin rava bemachoza: dedaru beducheka — lidro berigla. dedaru berigla — lidro beagra. dedaru beagra — lidro beachpa. dedaru beachpa — nifros sudara illaveh, veim la efshar — shere. deamar mar: im i efshar leshannot — muttar.

Amar leh rav chanan bar rava lerav ashe: amur rabbanan kamma deefshar leshannoye meshannenan beyoma tava. veha hane neshe deka malyayn chatzvayyhu mayya beyoma tava, vela ka meshanneyayn, vela amrinan lehu vela midde!
Amar leh: mishshum dela efshar. hecha lebad? demalya bechatzba rabba timle bechatzba zuta — ka mappesha behillucha.

Demalya bechatzba zuta timle bechatzba rabba — ka mappesha bemassoy. techasseyeh benichtema — zimnin denafel veate leetoye. tiktereh — zimnin demippesik veate lemiktereh. tifros sudara illaveh — zimnin demittemish bemayya veate lide sechita. hilkach la efshar.
Amar leh rava bar rav chanin leabbaye, tenan: en metappechin veen mesappekin veen merakkedin, vehaiddana deka chazenan deavdan hachi, vela amrinan lehu vela midde?

Amar leh: uletamach ha deamar (rava): la letev inish appumma delichya, dilma miggandar leh chefetz veate leetoye (arba ammot birshut harabbim), veha hane neshe deshaklan chatzvayyhu, veazlan veyatvan appumma dimvoa, vela amrinan lehu vela midde!
Ella: hannach lahem leyisrael, mutav sheyyihyu shoggin veal yihyu mezidin. hacha name: hannach lahem leyisrael, mutav sheyyihyu shoggin veal yihyu mezidin.

Vehane mille bidrabbanan, aval bidorayyta — la. vela hi, la shena bidorayyta vela shena bidrabbanan, la amrinan lehu vela midde, deha tosefet yom hakkippurim deorayyta hu, veachli veshatu ad shechashcha, vela amrinan lehu vela midde.
Umatchilin baaremat hatteven. amar rav kahana: zot omeret, matchilin baotzar techilla. manni — rabbi shimon hi, delet leh muketze.
Ema sefa: aval lo baetzim shebbammuketze. atan lerabbi yehuda, deit leh muketze! hacha bearze veashshuche askinan, demuketze mechamat chesron kis, vaafillu rabbi shimon mode.

Ikka dematne la assefa: aval lo baetzim shebbammuketze. amar rav kahana: zot omeret, en matchilin baotzar techilla. manni — rabbi yehuda hi, deit leh muketze. ema resha: matchilin baaremat hatteven, atan lerabbi shimon delet leh muketze! hatam betivna sarya.
Tivna sarya, ha chaze letina! deit beh kotzim.
b: Mishna en notlin etzim min hassukka, ella min hassamuch lah.
Gemara may shena min hassukka dela — deka satar uhla, min hassamuch lah name — ka satar uhla?
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: may samuch — samuch laddefanot. rav menashsheya amar: afillu tema besheen samuch laddefanot, ki tanya hahi — beissureyayta.

Tanya rabbi chiyyay bar yosef kammeh derabbi yochanan: en notlin etzim min hassukka ella min hassamuch lah, verabbi shimon mattir. veshavin besukkat hachag bechag — sheasura. veim hitna aleha — hakkol lefi tenao.

Verabbi shimon mattir? veha ka satar uhla! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hacha besukka nofelet askinan, verabbi shimon letameh, delet leh muketze. detanya: motar hashshemen shebbanner veshebbakkeara — asur. verabbi shimon mattir.
Mi dame? hatam adam yoshev umetzappe ematay tichbe nero, hacha adam yoshev umetzappe ematay tippol sukkato?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hacha besukka reua askinan, demeetmol dateh illava.
Veshavin besukkat hechag bechag shehi asura, veim hitna aleha — hakkol lefi tenao. umi mahane ba tenay?

Vehaamar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi akiva: minnayin laatze sukka sheasurin kol shiva — shenneemar: "chag hassukkot shivat yamim laAdonai", vetanya, rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: minnayin shekkeshem shechal shem shamayim al hachagiga, kach chal shem shamayim al hassukka — talmud lomar: "chag hassukkot shivat yamim laAdonai", ma chag laAdonai — af sukka laAdonai.
Amar rav menashsheya bereh derava: sefa atan lesukka dealma, aval sukka demitzva — la mahane ba tenaa.

Vesukka demitzva la? vehatanya: sikkechah kehilchatah veitterah bikramim uvisdinin hametzuyyayrin, vetala bah egozim shekedim afarsekim verimmonim ufarkile anavim, yenot shemanim uselatot veatrot shibbolim — asur lehistappek mehen ad motzae yom tov haacharon shel chag. veim hitna alehem — hakkol lefi tenao.
Abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: beomer eni bodel mehem kol ben hashshemashot, dela chala kedushsha alayyhu. aval atze sukka, dechala kedushsha alayyhu — ittaktzay leshiva.
Umay shena meha deittemar: hifrish shiva etrogim leshivat hayyamim, amar rav: kol achat veachat yotze bah veochlah lealtar. verav assi amar: kol achat yotze bah veochlah lemachar!
Hatam, demafseku lelot miyyamim — kol chad vechad yoma mitzva beappe nafsheh hu. hacha, dela mafseku lelot miyyamim — kullehu yome kachada yoma arichta dame.

a: Mishna meviin etzim min hassade — min hamechunnas, umin hakkarpef — afillu min hamefuzzar. ezehu karpef — kol shessamuch leir, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: kol shennichnasin lo befotachat, vaafillu betoch techum shabbat.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en meviin etzim ella min hamechunnasin shebbakkarpef. veha anan tenan: min hakkarpef — vaafillu min hamefuzzarim! matnitin yechidaa hi.

Detanya, amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al hamefuzzarim shebbassadot — sheen meviin, veal hamechunnasin shebbakkarpef — shemmeviin. al ma nechleku — al hamefuzzarim shebbakkarpef veal hamechunnasin shebbassadot, shebbet shammay omrim: lo yavi, uvet hillel omrim: yavi.
Amar rava: ale kanim vaale gefanim, af al gav dimchannefi lehu umotvi, kevan dei middele zika mevaddar lehu — kimfuzzarim damu vaasurin. vei atnach mana meetmol alayyhu — shappir dame.
Ezehu karpef vechulei. ibbaya lehu: hechi kaamar, kol shessamuch lair — vehu deit leh potachat, vaata rabbi yose lememar: kevan deit leh potachat — afillu betoch techum shabbat name.

O dilma hachi kaamar: kol shessamuch lair — ben deit leh potachat, ben delet leh potachat, vaata rabbi yose lememar: afillu betoch techum shabbat, vedavka deit leh potachat, aval let leh potachat — afillu samuch lair name la.

Ta shema: middekatane, rabbi yose omer: kol shennichnasin lo befotachat — vaafillu betoch techum shabbat, shema minna rabbi yose tarte lekulla kaamar. shema minna. amar rav salla amar rabbi yirmeya: halacha kerabbi yose lehakel.
Mishna en mevakkein etzim lo min hakkorot velo min hakkora shennishbera beyom tov. veen mevakkein lo bekardom velo bimgera velo bemaggal, ella bekofitz.
b: Gemara vehaamrat resha en mevakkein kelal? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: chassore mechassera vehachi katane: en mevakkein min hassevar shel korot, velo min hakkora shennishbera beyom tov. aval mevakkein min hakkora shennishbera meerev yom tov.

Ucheshehen mevakkein — en mevakkein lo bekardom velo bemaggal velo bimgera, ella bekofitz. tanya name hachi: en mevakkein etzim lo min hassevar shel korot velo min hakkora shennishbera beyom tov, lefi sheeno min hammuchan.
Velo bekardom. amar rav chinnana bar shelemya mishshemeh derav: lo shanu ella benakvut shello, aval bezachrut shello — muttar.
Peshita, bekofitz tenan! mahu detema: hane mille kofitz lechodeh, aval kardom vekofitz, ema: miggo dehay gisa asur — hay gisa name asur, ka mashma lan.

Veikka dematne la assefa: ella bekofitz. amar rav chinnana bar shelemya mishshemeh derav: lo shanu ella bezachrut shello, aval benakvut shello — asur. peshita, velo bekardom tenan! mahu detema: hane mille kardom, aval kofitz vekardom, ema: miggo dehay gisa shere — hay gisa name shere, ka mashma lan.
Mishna bayit shehu male perot venifchat — notel mimmekom happechat. rabbi meir omer: af pochet lechattechilla venotel.

Gemara ammay? veha ka satar uhla! amar rav nechumi bar adda amar shemuel: beavvera delivne. ini?! vehaamar rav nachman: hane livne deiyyaytur mibbinyana — shere letaltolinhu beshabbeta, hoil vachaze lemizge alayyhu. sharginhu — vadday aktzinhu!
Amar rabbi zera: beyom tov amru, aval lo beshabbat. tanya name hachi, rabbi meir omer: af pochet lechattechilla venotel. beyom tov amru, aval lo beshabbat.
Amar shemuel: chotamot shebbakkarka — mattir, aval lo mafkia velo chotech. shebbakkelim — mattir umafkia vechotech, echad shabbat veechad yom tov.
Metivi: chotamot shebbakkarka, beshabbat — mattir aval lo mafkia velo chotech. beyom tov — mattir umafkia vechotech!

Ha manni — rabbi meir hi, deamar: af pochet lechattechilla venotel, ufeligi rabbanan aleh, vaana daamari kerabbanan. umi peligi rabbanan aleh bechotamot shebbakkarka? vehatanya: modim chachamim lerabbi meir bechotamot shebbakkarka, shebbeshabbat mattir — aval lo mafkia velo chotech, beyom tov — mattir umafkia vechotech!

a: Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: chotamot shebbakkarka — mattir, aval lo mafkia velo chotech, echad shabbat veechad yom tov. veshebbakkeli — beshabbat mattir, aval lo mafkia velo chotech, beyom tov — mattir umafkia vechotech.
Taretzt lach resha, ella sefa kashya!
Ha manni — rabbi nechemya hi, deamar: kol hakkelim en nittalin ella derech tashmishan.
I rabbi nechemya, may irya shabbat? afillu yom tov name! vechi tema shanya leh lerabbi nechemya ben shevut shabbat lishvut yom tov, umi shanya leh?
Vehatane chada: massikin bechelim veen massikin beshivre chelim, vetanya iddach: massikin ben bechelim ben beshivre kelim, vetanya iddach: en massikin lo bechelim velo beshivre chelim.
Umeshanne, la kashya: ha rabbi yehuda, ha rabbi shimon, ha rabbi nechemya!
Tere tannae veallibba derabbi nechemya.
Mishna en pochatin et hanner mippene shehu ose keli, veen osin pechamin beyom tov, veen chotchin et happetila. rabbi yehuda omer: chotchah baur.

Gemara man tena difchitat ner mana hu? amar rav yosef: rabbi meir hi. detanya: keli cheres, meematay mekabbel tumea — mishshennigmera melachto, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehoshua omer: mishsheyyitzrefo bakkivshan.
Amar leh abbaye: mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam ella dachaze lekabbole beh midde, aval hacha lemay chazi? lekabbole beh peshite.
Ikka deamri, amar rav yosef: rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok hi, ditnan: ilpasin chiraniyyot — tehorot beohel hammet, utemeot bemassa hazzav.
Rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok omer: af tehorot bemassa hazzav, lefi shello nigmera melachtan.
Amar leh abbaye: dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok hatam, ella dachaze lekabbole beh midde, aval hacha lemay chaze? lekabbole beh peshite.

Tanu rabbanan: en pochatin et hanner, veen osin ilpasin chiraniyyot beyom tov. rabban shimon ben gamliel mattir beilpasin chiraniyyot. may chiraniyyot? amar rav yehuda: iraniyyot. may iraniyyot? amar abbaye: tzae chaklayayta.
Veen osin pechamin. peshita, lemay chaze? tane rabbi chiyyay: lo nitzrecha ella lemosran leolyayrin levo bayyom.
Uvo bayyom mi shere? kidamar rava: lehazzia, vekodem gezera. hacha name: lehazzia, vekodem gezera.
Veen chotchin et happetila lishnayim. may shena besakkin dela —
b: Dekamtakken mana, baur name ka metakken mana! tane rabbi chiyyay: chotchah baur befi shete nerot. amar rav natan bar abba amar rav: mochatin et happetila beyom tov. may "mochatin"? amar rav chanina bar shelemya (mishshemeh derav): leaddoye chushecha.
