Tane bar kappara: shishsha devarim neemru biftila. shelosha lehachemir, ushelosha lehakel. lehachemir: en godlin otah lechattechilla beyom tov, veen mehavehavin otah baur, veen chotchin otah lishnayim. lehakel: memaachah bayyad, veshorah beshemen, vechotchah baur befi shete nerot.
Veamar rav natan bar abba amar rav: attire bavel, yorde gehinnam hem. ki ha deshabbetay bar marinus ikkela levavel, bea minnayyhu iska — vela yehavu leh. mezone mezan — name la zaynuhu.

Amar: hane meerev rav ka atu, dichtiv: "venatan lecha rachamim verichamcha", kol hamerachem al habberiyyot — beyadua shehu mizzaro shel avraham avinu, vechol mi sheeno merachem al habberiyyot — beyadua sheeno mizzaro shel avraham avinu.

Veamar rav natan bar abba amar rav: kol hametzappe al shulchan acherim — olam chashach baado, shenneemar: "noded hu lallechem ayye yada ki nachon beyado yom choshech". rav chisda amar: af chayyav enan chayyim.

Tanu rabbanan: shelosha chayyehen enam chayyim, veellu hen: hametzappe leshulchan chavero, umi sheishto moshelet alav, umi sheyyissurin moshlin begufo. veyesh omrim: af mi sheen lo ella chaluk echad. vetanna kamma: efshar dimayyen bemaneh.
Mishna en shovrin et hacheres, veen chotchin hanneyayr litzlot bo maliach.
Veen gorfin tannur vechirayim, aval mechabbeshin.
Veen makkifin shete chaviyyot lishpot alehen et hakkedera, veen somchin et hakkedera babbekaat, vechen baddelet. veen manhigin et habbehema bammakkel beyom tov, verabbi elazar berabbi shimon mattir.
Gemara may tama — mishshum deka metakken mana.

Veen gorfin tannur vechirayim. tane rav chiyyay bar yosef kammeh derav nachman: veim i efshar leefot ella im ken gorfo — muttar. devethu derabbi chiyyay nefal la aricha betannura beyoma tava, amar la rabbi chiyyay: chazay, daana rifta meallayyta baena. amar leh rava leshammaeh: tevi li bar avoza, veizdehar mecharocha.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: amar lan rav acha mehutzal, demar sharkin leh tannura beyoma tava. amar leh: anan arakta difrat samchinan, vehane mille hu detzayyeyreh meetmol. amar ravina: vekitma — shere.

Veen makkifin shete chaviyyot. amar rav nachman: avanim shel bet hakkisse, muttar letzaddedan beyom tov. etiveh rabba lerav nachman: en makkifin shete chaviyyot lishpot alehen et hakkedera! amar leh: shane hatam, mishshum deka aved uhla.

Amar leh rabba zuta, lerav ashe: ella meatta, bana itzteva beyom tov, dela aved uhla — hachi name dishre? amar leh: hatam, binyan keva asra tora, binyan aray la asra tora. ugezaru rabbanan al binyan aray mishshum binyan keva, vehacha mishshum kevodo la gezaru beh rabbanan.
Amar rav yehuda: hay medureta, millemala lematta — shere. millematta lemala — asur.

a: Vechen beata, vechen kedera, vechen pureya, vechen chavita.

Veen somchin et hakkedera babbekaat, vechen baddelet. baddelet salka datach?! ella ema: vechen haddelet. tanu rabbanan: en somchin et hakkedera babbekaat, vechen haddelet, lefi shello nittenu etzim ella lehassaka. verabbi shimon mattir.

Veen manhigin et habbehema bammakkel beyom tov, verabbi elazar berabbi shimon mattir. lema rabbi elazar berabbi shimon kaavu sevira leh, delet leh muketze? la, beha afillu rabbi shimon mode, mishshum demichaze keman deazel lechinga.

Chizra, rav nachman asar, verav sheshet share. berattiva — kulle alma la peligi deasur. ki peligi — beyabbishta. man deasar, amar lach: lo nittenu etzim ella lehassaka. uman deshare, amar lach: ma li litzlot bo, ma li litzlot begachalto?

Ikka deamri: beyabbishta — kulle alma la peligi dishre. ki peligi — berattivta. man deasar, dela chaze lehassaka, uman deshare amar lach: ha chaze lehessek gadol. vehilcheta: yabbishta shere, rattivta asir.
Daresh rava: ishsha lo tikkanes ledir haetzim littol mehen ud. veud shennishbar — asur lehassiko beyom tov, lefi shemmassikin bechelim, veen massikin beshivre chelim.
Lememra derava kerabbi yehuda sevira leh, deit leh muketze? veha amar leh rava leshammaeh: tevi li bar avoza ushedi meeh leshunnara! hatam kevan demasrechi — meetmol dateh illaveh.

Mishna rabbi eliezer omer: notel adam kesam mishshellefanav, lachtzotz bo shinnav. umegabbev min hechatzer umadlik, shekkol ma shebbechatzer — muchan hu. vachachamim omrim: megabbev mishshellefanav umadlik.
En motziin et haur lo min haetzim, velo min haavanim, velo min heafar velo min harafim, velo min hammayim. veen melabbenin et harafim litzlot bahen.
Gemara amar rav yehuda:
b: Ochle behema — en bahen mishshum tikkun keli.

Etiveh rav kahana lerav yehuda: metaltelin atze besamim lehariach bahen, ulehanif bahen lachole, umollo umeriach bo. velo yiktemennu lehariach bo, veim ketamo — patur aval asur. lachtzotz bo shinnav — la yiktemennu, veim ketamo — chayyayv chattat!
Amar leh: hasheta patur aval asur ka kashya li, chayyayv chattat mibbaya? ella: ki tanya hahi bekashin. kashin bene melila ninhu?

Chassore mechassera vehachi katane: mollo umeriach bo, kotmo umeriach bo. bamme devarim amurim — berakkin, aval bekashin — lo yiktemennu, veim ketamo — patur aval asur. lachtzotz bo shinnav — lo yiktemennu, veim ketamo — chayyayv chattat.
Tane chada: kotmo umeriach bo, tanya iddach: lo yiktemennu lehariach bo. amar rabbi zera amar rav chisda, la kashya: ha — berakkin, ha — bekashin.

Matkef la rav acha bar yaakov: bekashin ammay la? may shena meha ditnan: shover adam et hechavit leechol mimmenna gerogrot, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot keli! veod: ha rava bar rav adda veravin bar rav adda deamri tarvayyhu: ki havenan be rav yehuda, hava mefashshach veyahev lan alvata alvata, af al gav dechazya lekattata denarge vachatzine.

La kashya: ha rabbi eliezer, ha rabbanan. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: notel adam kesam mishshellefanav lachtzotz bo shinnav, vachachamim omrim: lo yittol ella meevus shel behema. veshavin shello yiktemennu, veim ketamo lachtzotz bo shinnav veliftoach bo haddelet, beshogeg beshabbat — chayyayv chattat, bemezid beyom tov — sofeg et haarbaim, divre rabbi eliezer.

Vachachamim omrim: echad ze veechad ze, eno ella mishshum shevut. rabbi eliezer dekaamar hatam chayyayv chattat — hacha patur aval asur. rabbanan deka amri hatam patur aval asur — hacha muttar lechattechilla.
Velet leh lerabbi eliezer ha ditnan: shover adam et hechavit leechol mimmenna gerogrot, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot keli? amar rav ashe: ki tanya hahi, bemusetaki.

Umegabbev min hechatzer. tanu rabbanan: megabbev min hechatzer umadlik, shekkol ma shebbechatzer muchan hu, uvilvad shello yaase tzibburin tzibburin. verabbi shimon mattir. bemay ka mippalgi? mar savar: michaze deka mechannef limchar uleyoma acharina. umar savar: kederato mochachat alav.
En motziin et haur vechulei. may tama? mishshum deka moled beyom tov.
Veen melabbenin et harafim. may ka aved? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: hacha birafim chadashim askinan, mippene

a: Shetztzarich levodkan. veamri la: mippene shetztzarich lechosman.

Tenan hatam: derasah o shetterafah bakkotel, o shertzatzatta behema umefarkeset, veshahata meet leet ushechatah — keshera. amar rabbi elazar bar yannay mishshum rabbi elazar ben antignos: tzericha bedika.
Bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: mahu leshochtah beyom tov? mi machzekinan reuta beyom tov, o la?
Amar leh, tenena: en melabbenin et harafim litzlot bahen. vahavenan ba: may ka aved? veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: hacha birafim chadashim askinan, mippene shetztzarich levodkan.
Amar leh: anan mippene shetztzarich lechosman matninan la.

Tanya: echad mevi et haur, veechad mevi et haetzim, veechad shofet et hakkedera, veechad mevi et hammayim, veechad noten betocho tavlin, veechad megis — kullan chayyayvin. vehatanya: acharon chayyayv vechullan peturin! la kashya: ha deayyti ur meikkara, ha deayyti ur levassof.
Bishlama kullehu ka avdi maase, ella shofet et hakkedera may ka aved? amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: hacha bikdera chadasha askinan, umishshum libbun reafim nagu bah.

Tanu rabbanan: tannur vechirayim chadashim — hare hen kechol hakkelim hannittalin bechatzer. aval en sachin otam shemen, veen tashin otan bematlit, veen mefigin otan betzonen kede lechosman, veim bishvil leefot — hare ze muttar.
Tanu rabbanan: molgin et harosh veet haraglayim umehavhavin otan baur, aval en toflin otam becharsit, velo baadama, velo besid. veen gozzin otan bemisparayim.
Veen gozzin et hayyarak battisporet shello. aval metakkenin et hakkunedas veet haakkaviyyot, umassikin veofin befureni, umechammin chammin beantichi, veen ofin befureni chadasha shemma tippachet.

Tanu rabbanan: en nofchin bemappuach, aval nofchin bishfoferet. veen metakkenin et hashshappud, veen mechaddedin oto. tanu rabbanan: en mefatztzein et hakkane litzlot bo maliach, aval mefatztzein et haegoz bematlit, veen choshshin shemma tikkara.
Mishna veod amar rabbi eliezer: omed adam al hammuketze
b: Erev shabbat bashsheviit, veomer: mikkan ani ochel lemachar. vachachamim omrim: ad sheyyirshom veyomar mikkan vead kan.

Gemara tenan hatam: tinokot shettamnu teenim meerev shabbat veshachchu velo isseru — lemotzae shabbat lo yochlu ella im ken isseru. utenan name: hammaavir teenim bachatzero lekatztzot — banav uvene beto ochlin mehen aray ufeturim.

Bea minneh rava merav nachman: shabbat, mahu shettikba muketze lemaaser bedavar shello nigmera melachto? mi amrinan, kevan dichtiv: "vekarata lashshabbat oneg", kava vaafillu bedavar shello nigmera melachto, o dilma: bedavar shennigmera melachto — kava, bedavar shello nigmera melachto — la kava?

Amar leh: shabbat kovaat, ben bedavar shennigmera melachto, ben bedavar shello nigmera melachto. amar leh: veema shabbat dumeya dechatzer, ma chatzer — enah kovaat ella bedavar shennigmera melachto, af shabbat — lo tikba ella bedavar shennigmera melachto! amar leh: talmud aruch hu beyadenu shehashshabbat kovaat, ben bedavar shennigmera melachto, ben bedavar shello nigmera melachto.

Amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman: af anan name tenena, veod amar rabbi eliezer: omed adam al hammuketze erev shabbat bashsheviit vechulei. tama dishviit — delav bar assore hu, ha bishar shene shavua — hachi name deasur, may tama — lav mishshum deshabbat kava?

La, shane hatam, kevan deamar: "mikkan ani ochel lemachar" — kava leh illaveh. i hachi may irya shabbat, afillu bechol name! ha ka mashma lan detevel muchan hu etzel shabbat, sheim avar vetikkeno — metukkan.

a: Vahalo motaro chozer, veshaminan leh lerabbi eliezer deamar: kol hecha demotaro chozer — la kava!

Ditnan: hannotel zetim min hammaatan — tovel achat achat bemelach veochel. veim taval venatan lefanav asara — chayyayv. rabbi eliezer omer: min hammaatan tahor — chayyayv, min hammaatan tame — patur, mippene shehu machazir et hammotar.
Vehavenan ba: may shena resha umay shena sefa? veamar rabbi avahu: resha bemaatan tahor vegavra tame, dela matze mahdar leh.
Sefa bemaatan tame vegavra tame, dematze mahdar leh.
Matnitin name bemuketze tahor vegavra tame, dela matze mahdar leh. vahalo muchezarin veomdin hen!

Ella, amar rav shimi bar ashe: rabbi eliezer ka amrat? rabbi eliezer letameh, deamar: teruma kava, vechol shekken shabbat. ditnan: perot shetteraman ad shello nigmera melachtan, rabbi eliezer oser leechol mehen aray, vachachamim mattirin.

Ta shema missefa, vachachamim omrim: ad sheyyirshom veyomar "mikkan vead kan". tama deerev shabbat bashsheviit — delav bar assore hu, ha bishar shene shavua, divne assore ninhu — asurim. may tama, lav mishshum deshabbat kava?

La, shane hatam, kevan deamar: "mikkan vead kan ani ochel lemachar" — kava leh. i hachi, may irya shabbat? afillu bechol name! ha ka mashma lan detevel muchan hu etzel shabbat, sheim avar vetikkeno — metukkan.
Ureminhi: haya ochel baeshkol, venichnas migginna lechatzer, rabbi eliezer omer: yigmor, rabbi yehoshua omer: lo yigmor.
Chashcha belele shabbat, rabbi eliezer omer: yigmor, rabbi yehoshua omer: lo yigmor!

Hatam kidkatane tama, rabbi natan omer: lo kesheamar rabbi eliezer "yigmor" — bechatzer yigmor, ella: yotze chutz lechatzer veyigmor. velo kesheamar rabbi eliezer "yigmor" — beshabbat yigmor, ella mamtin lemotzae shabbat veyigmor.
Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: echad shabbat, veechad teruma, veechad chatzer, veechad mikkach — kullan en kovin, ella bedavar shennigmera melachtan.
Shabbat — leappoke middehillel, detanya: hameammer perot mimmakom lemakom liktzor, vekiddesh alehen hayyom, amar rabbi yehuda: hillel leatzmo oser.
b: Chatzer — leappoke midderabbi yaakov. ditnan: hammaavir teenim bachatzero lekatztzot — banav uvene beto ochlin mehen aray, ufeturim min hammaaser. vetane ala: rabbi yaakov mechayyev, verabbi yose berabbi yehuda poter.
Teruma — leappoke midderabbi eliezer. ditnan: perot shetteraman ad shello nigmera melachtan, rabbi eliezer oser leechol mehen aray, vachachamim mattirin.
Mikkach — (keditnan) hallokeach teenim meam haaretz, bimkom sherov bene adam dorsin, ochel mehen aray, umeasseran demay.

Shema minna telat. shema minna: mikkach enah kovaat ella bedavar shennigmera melachto, ushema minna: rov amme haaretz measserin hen, ushema minna: measserin demay meamme haaretz afillu bedavar shello nigmera melachto.

Uleappoke meha ditnan: hammachalif perot im chavero, ze leechol veze leechol, ze lekatztzot veze lekatztzot, ze leechol veze lekatztzot — chayyayv. rabbi yehuda omer: leechol — chayyayv, lekatztzot — patur.
Hadaran alach hammevi
Mashshilin perot derech arubba beyom tov, aval lo beshabbat. umechassim perot bechelim mippene haddelef, vechen kadde yayin vechadde shemen. venotnin keli tachat haddelef beshabbat.
Gemara ittemar: rav yehuda verav natan, chad tane "mashshilin", vechad tane "mashchilin".

Amar mar zutera: man detane "mashshilin" la mishtabbash, uman detane "mashchilin" la mishtabbash. man detane "mashshilin" la mishtabbash, dichtiv: "ki yishshal zetecha". uman detane "mashchilin" la mishtabbash, ditnan: hashshachul vehakkasul. shachul — shennishmeta yerecho, kasul — sheechad miyyarchotav gevoha mechavertah.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: man detane "mashshirin" la mishtabbash, uman detane "mashchirin" la mishtabbash, uman detane "manshirin" la mishtabbash.

Man detane "mashshirin" la mishtabbash, ditnan, rabbi yishmael omer: nazir lo yachof rosho baadama, mippene shemmashshir et hassear. uman detane "mashchirin" la mishtabbash, ditnan: hashshechor vehazzug shel sapparim, af al pi shennechleku — temein.
Uman detane "manshirin" la mishtabbash, ditnan: mi shennashru kelav bammayim — mehallech bahem veeno choshesh. i name meha ditnan: ezehu leket — hannosher bishat ketzira.

Tenan: mashshilin perot derech arubba beyom tov. ad kamma? amar rabbi zera amar rabbi assi, veamri la amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: keotah sheshshaninu: mefannin arba vechamesh kuppot shel teven veshel tevua mippene haorchim, umippene bittul bet hammidrash.

Vedilma shane hatam, deikka bittul bet hammidrash, aval hacha delekka bittul bet hammidrash — la. i name: hatam hayeynu tama, dearba vechamesh kuppot shere mishshum shabbat dachamira vela ate lezalzole bay, aval yom tov dekil veate lezalzole beh — kelal kelal la.
I name leiddach gisa: hatam hayeynu tama, delekka hefsed mamon, aval hacha deikka hefsed mamon, afillu tuva name.
